blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A latent diffusion model's output has already passed through its autoencoder, so a second round trip changes it very little. This "déjà vu" underlies reconstruction-based detectors of generated images; we analyse when it reveals a generated image and when it does not. Read by a frozen vision foundation model without training, the trace is strongest in intermediate layers, and, unlike pixel-level reconstruction error, it treats blur as a sign of a real image. It belongs to the generator's exact decoder: on Synthbuster, the exact decoders of Stable Diffusion 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL are the strongest of eight autoencoders and catch 94-100% of their generators' images at a 5% false-alarm rate (SDXL's version identified post hoc), while near-identical versions catch 7-42%. A detector trained only on real photographs and their autoencoder copies matches one trained on 162k generated images on GenImage (+2.3 points, 95% CI [0.9, 3.7]) and complements it in fusion, but one resize with JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs it 19-27 points. Two lessons concern benchmarks. The in-the-wild benchmark Chameleon can be solved from image width alone. And on Synthbuster, how the real photographs are matched to the generated images' size decides whether our detector leads or trails (+4.4 or -9.7 points): the matching protocol alone can reverse a detector comparison. Code and per-image scores: https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Most images produced by today’s generators are decoded by an autoencoder.
A latent diffusion model denoises in a compressed latent space and then decodes the result into pixels ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , so its output lies, by construction, close to the set of images that the decoder can produce.
Pass such an image through the same autoencoder once more and it barely moves. A real photograph moves further, because it never had to fit the decoder.
This asymmetry, an image being a near fixed point of an autoencoder, is the premise behind reconstruction-based detectors ( Ricker et al., 2024 ) and behind training on reconstructed real images ( Rajan et al., 2025 ) .
We call it the déjà vu of a generated image ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
今天的发电机所产生的大多数图像都由自动编码器解码.
一个潜在的扩散模型 denoise 在压缩的潜在空间,然后解码结果成像素(Rombach等, 2022年), 因此它的输出通过构造, 接近解码器可以产生的一组图像.
再通过同一个自动编码器传递一次这样的图像,它几乎不动. 真正的相片走得更远,因为它从来就不需要装入解码器.
这个不对称的图像是自动编码器的近乎固定的点,它是基于重建的探测器(Ricker等,2024年)和关于重建真实图像的培训的前提(Rajan等,2025年)。
我们称它为已生成的图像(图1)。

AUROC of the training-free signal per DINOv3 layer on GenImage (blue; mean over eight generators), and of blurred real images against the originals (grey; a high value would mean that the score mistakes blur for generation). blocks.en:
The premise is appealing because it promises detection without examples of the generator.
If generated images are recognisable by how little they change under an autoencoder, a detector could be trained on real photographs alone and still catch every generator that uses that autoencoder.
Existing detectors only partly test this promise. Reconstruction-error detectors use the signal without training, but they are fragile to compression and flag degraded real photographs ( Section 6 ). Detectors trained with reconstructions of real images as fakes ( Rajan et al., 2025 ) train a full network end to end, so where the trace is visible in a representation, and what destroys it, is not isolated.
blocks.zh:
这个前提很有吸引力,因为它保证在没有生成者的例子的情况下进行检测。
如果生成的图像能识别出它们在自动编码器下变化很小,那么探测器可以单独接受真实相片的训练,仍然能捕捉到每一个使用自动编码器的生成器.
现有的探测器只是部分测试这一承诺. 重建-erroor探测器在没有训练的情况下使用信号,但容易被压缩并标出退化的真实相片(第6节. 接受过真实图像再造假象培训的探测器(Rajan等,2025年)训练了一个完整的网络结束来结束,因此,在一种代表物中可以看见的痕迹,以及破坏它的东西,并不是孤立的。

blocks.en:
This paper is an analysis of that premise, not a new detector. We measure the déjà vu with a frozen vision foundation model, DINOv3 ( Siméoni and others, 2025 ) , and build a measuring instrument around it, Déjà VAE ( Figure 1 a). Déjà VAE copies an image with an autoencoder and reads image and copy at intermediate layers. It then either scores how little the image moved (Déjà VAE-TF, no training) or applies a small head trained on real photographs and their copies only. Déjà VAE-I reads the image alone, and Déjà VAE-P reads it together with its copy. Training without generated images is not new ( Rajan et al., 2025 ; Cozzolino et al., 2024 ; Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ) ; we use it because it isolates the one trace we want to study. Holding backbone, head and protocol fixed, we then vary one factor at a time: the layer, the backbone, how the copy is made, the decoder, the processing after generation, and the benchmark.
With this instrument we ask six questions, each answered in its own section: 1. Where is the trace visible? Without training, mainly in intermediate layers and much less at the final one; there, unlike pixel-level reconstruction error, it treats blur as a sign of a real image ( Section 4 ). In our setup, probes trained on generated images flag only 15–25% of autoencoder copies of real photographs, reproducing the blindness reported for final-layer probes ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) ; heads trained on the copies flag 50% of them at the final layer and 98% at layers 8–18 ( Appendix E ). 2. Whose trace is it? The generator’s exact decoder. On Synthbuster, without training, the exact decoder is the strongest of eight autoencoders for each of SD 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL (the SDXL version identified post hoc) and catches 94–100% of their images, while near-identical versions of the same decoders catch 7–42%, however the real photographs are matched in size. Retraining Déjà VAE with a different copy decoder moves results in the directions we predicted ( Section 5 ). 3. Does a detector trained without fakes work? On GenImage, yes: Déjà VAE-I detects 87.5% of fakes at a 5% false-alarm rate, on par with or above a detector trained on 162k generated images, and far above two training-free baselines ( Section 6 ). On Synthbuster, whether it leads or trails that detector depends on how the real photographs are matched to the generated images’ size ( + 4.4 +4.4 or − 9.7 -9.7 points): the matching alone can reverse a detector comparison ( Section 7 ). 4. What breaks it? One resize with JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs the trained detectors 19–27 points, while a semantic detector loses at most 8; processing-aware training does not help on web images ( Section 8 ). 5. Is the in-the-wild benchmark measuring what we think? Every real image in Chameleon ( Yan et al., 2025 ) is exactly 500 pixels wide, while only 1 of 11,170 generated images is. We build a size-matched version and separate the shortcut from the cost of processing ( Section 9 ). 6. Is the signal still useful? As a complement: fusing Déjà VAE with a semantic detector improves it on all three benchmarks, beats control ensembles, and keeps false alarms on degraded photographs at the base rate ( Section 10 ). Along the way we contribute a size-matched Chameleon with a processing-only control, two matched versions of Synthbuster, and per-image scores for every method, all under one protocol: thresholds from real images only, paired bootstrap intervals, and predictions written down before the experiments that test them ( Section 3.4 ). Code and scores are available at https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae .

Déjà VAE-I单独读出画面,Déjà VAE-P随同影印. 没有生成图像的培训并非新鲜事(Rajan等,2025年;Cozzolino等,2024年;Karageorgiou等,2025年;我们使用它是因为它孤立了我们想要研究的一个痕迹。 持有主干线,头和协议固定,然后我们一次改变一个因素:层,主干线,复制品的制作方式,解码器,再生成处理,以及基准.
通过这一工具,我们提出了六个问题,每个问题都在自己的一节中回答: 1. 踪迹在哪里可见? 没有训练,主要在中间地层,最后地层则少得多;在那里,与像素级重建错误不同,它把模糊作为真实图像的标志(第4节. 在我们的设定中,对生成的图像的探测器只进行了15-25%真实照片的自编码器复制,复制了最终层探测器(周等,2026年)报告的失明;对复制器的探测器进行了最终层层50%和8-18层98%(附录E)的培训。 2. 是谁的追踪? 发电机的确切解码器。 在Synthbuster上,没有经过训练,精确的解码器是SD 1.3,1.4,2和XL(SDXL版本确定后临时)各8个自动编码器中最强的,并捕获了94-100%的图像,而近同版本的同分解码器捕获了7-42%,然而真实相片的大小相匹配. 重新培训Déjà VAE, 使用不同的副本解码器, 3. 未经伪造而训练的探测器是否有效? 在GenImage上,是的:Déjà VAE-I以5%的假警报率检测出87.5%的假象,与经过162克生成的图像培训的探测器相同或更高,而且远远超过两个无训练基线(第6节)。 在Synthbuster上,探测器的导出或出轨取决于真实相片如何与生成的图像相匹配大小(+ 4.4+4.4或− 9.7-9.7分):单是匹配就可以逆向检测器比较(第7节). 4. 是什么打破了它? 用 JPEG 重新保存或轻度模糊的调整大小,使训练有素的探测器花费了19–27分,而语义探测器最多损失了8分;处理-意识训练对网络图像没有帮助(第8节). 5. 内在基准是否衡量我们的看法? Chameleon (Yan等,2025年)中的每一幅真实图像都正好是500像素宽,而11,170出品的图像只有一幅. 我们建造一个大小相匹配的版本,把快捷方式与处理费用分开(第9节)。 6. 信号是否仍然有用? 作为补充:用语义探测器将Déjà VAE引信用于改进所有三个基准,击败控制组合,并按基准率对已退化的照片进行假警报(第10节)。 沿途我们贡献出一个大小相匹配的变色龙, 只有一个处理控制, 两个匹配版本的合成器, 代码和分数见https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae。

blocks.en: We do not propose a state-of-the-art in-the-wild detector. Our claim is narrower and, we argue, more useful: we pin down when autoencoder traces reveal generated images, why they stop doing so on the open web, and how a benchmark can hide the difference.
blocks.zh: 我们不提议采用最先进的内测仪。 我们的说法比较狭义,而且,我们说,更有用的是:当自动编码器的痕迹显示生成的图像时,我们定下来,为什么它们停止在开放的网络上这样做,以及基准如何可以隐藏差异。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Linear probes and small heads on frozen CLIP or DINO features generalise across generators better than detectors trained end to end ( Ojha et al., 2023 ) . SimLBR ( Dhakal et al., 2026 ) trains a small head on DINOv3 class-token features and is the strongest such detector in our setting. Zhou et al. (2026) show that linear probes on the pooled final-layer features of recent foundation models, DINOv3 among them, match specialised detectors on standard benchmarks, but are “essentially blind” to real images that have only been passed through a diffusion model’s autoencoder. RIGID ( He et al., 2024 ) is training-free: it flags an image whose DINOv2 embedding changes a lot under small Gaussian noise. All of these read the backbone’s final layer. Without training, we find the autoencoder trace mainly in intermediate layers and much weaker at the final layer ( Section 4 ). In our setup, probes trained on generated images, like those of Zhou et al. (2026) , also flag only 15–25% of autoencoder copies of real photographs. Heads trained on the copies flag 50% of them at the final layer and 98% at layers 8–18 ( Appendix E ), so the blindness reflects both what a probe is trained on and which layer it reads.
blocks.zh: 冷冻的CLIP或DINO上的线性探测器和小头比经过训练的探测器更能使发电机通用(Ojha等,2023年)。 SimLBR(Dhakal等,2026年)在DINOv3级地块上训练出一头小头,是我们环境中最强的这种探测器. Zhou等人(2026年)显示,最近的基础模型的集合式最终层特征上的线性探测器,其中的DINov3,在标准基准上匹配了专门的探测器,但“基本上盲目”于只通过扩散模型的自编码器传递出的真实图像。 RIGID(He等,2024年)是无训练的:它标出一个在小高斯噪声下被DINov2嵌入会改变很多的图像. 所有这一切都读取了骨干的最后一层。 没有训练,我们发现自动编码器的痕量主要在中间层,在最后层则更弱(第4节)。 在我们的设定中,探测器对生成的图像进行了训练,比如周等人(2026年)的图像,也只标出15-25%的自定义相片副本. 头部在复制品上训练了50%的旗子在最后一层,98%的旗子在8–18层(附录E)上,因此失明既反映了探测器所训练的东西,也反映了它读到的哪一层。

blocks.en: DIRE ( Wang et al., 2023 ) and LaRE 2 ( Luo et al., 2024 ) detect diffusion images by how well a diffusion model reconstructs them, in pixel space and in latent space. AEROBLADE ( Ricker et al., 2024 ) scores an image by its LPIPS distance to its own autoencoder reconstruction, taking the minimum over several autoencoders; it needs no training, but it requires the generator’s autoencoder. AEDR ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses the ratio of two successive autoencoder reconstruction errors for training-free attribution. A second line uses reconstructions of real images as training data. DRCT ( Chen et al., 2024 ) treats diffusion reconstructions of real images as hard negatives for contrastive training. AlignedForensics ( Rajan et al., 2025 ) trains a detector end to end with autoencoder reconstructions of real images as the fakes, so that real and fake differ only in the autoencoder trace. DDA ( Chen et al., 2025 ) additionally aligns the high frequencies and mixes pixels between real images and their reconstructions. B-Free ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ) creates training fakes from real images with a diffusion model’s inpainting. Like AlignedForensics and DDA, our detector uses reconstructions of real images instead of generated images. Our aim differs: we use such a detector as an instrument to ask where the trace is visible, what it requires and what destroys it, holding the backbone, head and protocol fixed. Methodologically, ours reads a frozen foundation model at intermediate layers instead of training a network, copies at native resolution, optionally compares each image with its copy, and adds blur-matched counterfactual real images, without which false alarms on degraded photographs rise to 13–40% ( Section 6 ). We include an AlignedForensics-style reconstruction probe on the same frozen features as a baseline.
blocks.zh: DIRE(Wang等人,2023年)和LaRE 2(Luo等人,2024年)通过扩散模型如何在像素空间和潜伏空间重建来检测扩散图像. AEROBLADE(Ricker等,2024年)以其LPIPS距离给自己的自定义编码器重建打分一幅图像,取了几个自定义编码器的最低分数;它不需要训练,但需要发电机的自定义编码器. AEDR (Wang等, 2026) 使用相继两个自编码器重建出错的比例进行无培训归属. 第二行将真实图像的重建作为训练数据. DRCT (Chen等, 2024) 将真实图像的传播重建视为对比性训练的硬底. AconitionForensics (Rajan等,2025年) 训练出一个检测器以自动编码器重建真实图像作为假相来结束,因此真实和假只在自动编码器跟踪上有所不同. DDA(Chen等,2025年)在真实的图像和它们的重建之间额外地将高频对接并混合了像素. B-Free(Guillaro等,2025年)用扩散模型的涂装从真实图像中创造出训练假相. 我们的探测器与AcontentForensics和DDA一样,使用真实图像的重建,而不是生成的图像. 我们的目标不同:我们使用这种探测器作为仪器来询问追踪在哪里可见,它需要什么,是什么摧毁它,把骨干,头和协议固定住. 从方法上讲,我们的系统在中间层读取了被冻结的地基模型,而不是训练一个网络,用原生分辨率复制,可选地将每个图像与其复制相提并论,并增加模糊的反事实真实图像,没有这些图像,退化照片上的假警报上升到了13-40%(第6节)。 包括一个AconitionForensics式的重建探测器 在同样的被冻结的特征上作为基线。

blocks.en: Training without generated images is not new. ZED ( Cozzolino et al., 2024 ) measures how surprising an image is to a lossless coder trained on real images. SPAI ( Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ) learns the spectral distribution of real images through a reconstruction pretext task and flags images that do not fit it. Forensic self-descriptions ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ) model the residuals of real images and use them for zero-shot detection, attribution and clustering. Brokman et al. (2025) derive zero-shot scores from the probability manifold of a pre-trained diffusion model. These methods model real images in general; ours targets one specific trace, the autoencoder fixed point, which lets us test when that trace is present. We compare only with detectors that read the same frozen backbone or rely on the same autoencoder signal, so that differences can be attributed to the signal rather than to backbones and training data ( Section 11 ).
blocks.zh: 没有生成图像的培训不是新的。 ZED(Cozzolino等,2024年)衡量一个图像对一个受过真实图像培训的无损失编码器有多出人意料. SPAI(Karageorgiou等,2025年)通过重建借口任务来了解真实图像的光谱分布,并标出不符合它的图像. 法证自述(阮等,2025年)将真实影像的残片进行模型化,并用于零发探测,归属和集群. Brokman等人(2025年)从预先训练的传播模型的概率倍数中得出了零射分. 这些方法一般地模拟真实的图像; 我们的目标是一个特定的痕迹, 自动编码器的固定点, 它让我们测试是否有痕迹。 我们仅与读取同一种被冻结的主干线或依赖同一种自编码器信号的探测器进行比较,这样差异就可归因于信号而不是主干线和培训数据(第11节)。

blocks.en: Shortcut learning, where a model succeeds for the wrong reason, is well documented ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . For generated images, Grommelt et al. (2024) showed that GenImage’s real images are JPEG-compressed while its fakes are PNG, and that its fakes cluster in a few sizes, so detectors can learn compression and size instead of generation. Zhou and Wang (2026) show that conclusions about training-free detectors on GenImage flip with the LPIPS backbone, the preprocessing and the score direction, and that RIGID’s score is inverted on some latent diffusion generators; our RIGID results agree. Chameleon ( Yan et al., 2025 ) was introduced as a harder, in-the-wild benchmark and is now used to evaluate detectors on frozen foundation models ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) ; we find that it has its own, stronger size shortcut ( Section 9 ). Synthbuster ( Bammey, 2024 ) pairs each generated image with a real photograph, which lets us remove size as a cue image by image, and shows that how this is done matters ( Section 7 ).

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价协议

blocks.en: GenImage ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) : eight generators (ADM, BigGAN, GLIDE, Midjourney, VQDM, Stable Diffusion 1.4 and 1.5, Wukong), with 2,000 test fakes each, 11,200 test reals and 4,800 held-out calibration reals. GenImage’s real images are JPEG files and its fakes are PNG files ( Grommelt et al., 2024 ) . We therefore re-save every evaluation image as JPEG at quality 95, so that the file format carries no label information. Chameleon ( Yan et al., 2025 ) : 14,863 real and 11,170 generated images collected from the web. We hold out 4,458 of the reals for calibration. Size-matched Chameleon and its processing-only control are defined in Section 9 . Synthbuster ( Bammey, 2024 ) : 1,000 images from each of nine recent generators, each generated from a prompt describing one photograph of RAISE-1k ( Dang-Nguyen et al., 2015 ) and named after it. The generators output fixed sizes from 256 × 256 256\times 256 (GLIDE) to 2688 × 1536 2688\times 1536 (Firefly), while the RAISE photographs are camera images about 4,300–4,900 pixels wide, so size alone would separate the classes. We therefore pair each generated image with a real image made from its own RAISE photograph at exactly its size, in two ways. Downscaled (pre-specified): the photograph is centre-cropped to the generated image’s aspect ratio and resized to its size (bicubic, antialiased; median factor 1.6 for Firefly to 12.8 for GLIDE). Cropped (added after the downscaled results): a native-resolution centre crop at the generated image’s size, with no resampling. Neither is neutral. Downscaling could itself separate the classes, and a crop shows a small part of the scene at the camera’s pixel scale; Déjà VAE’s view of a cropped real covers about 5% of the photograph’s width, and the nine cropped reals of one photograph give Déjà VAE the same view. The generated images are left untouched; according to the dataset’s documentation, none was compressed or resampled. We split the RAISE photographs 50/50 (seed 23) into a calibration and a test half. One photograph is corrupt on the dataset’s server and is excluded with its nine generated images, leaving 4,500 calibration reals, 4,491 test reals and 8,991 generated images under each matching. blocks.en: The primary metric is the true-positive rate at 5% false positives (TPR@5%), per generator, averaged over generators ( mean ) and at the worst generator ( worst ). Every comparison is paired: the methods score the same images and use thresholds from the same calibration reals. For each difference we report the mean of its paired-bootstrap distribution ( B = 1,000 B=1{,}000 ) and the 95% percentile interval (the mean can differ by 0.1 points from the difference of table entries). Each draw resamples the calibration reals and each generator’s test fakes once, and every method and seed is evaluated on that same draw; on Synthbuster a draw resamples RAISE photographs instead, because each contributes nine matched reals and up to nine generated images. Across the three seeds, the standard deviation of mean TPR@5% is at most 0.9 points on GenImage and at most 2.8 points on the other benchmarks for every learned method, and Déjà VAE-I is above the released SimLBR head for each seed separately on GenImage and on Synthbuster with downscaled reals. blocks.en: At the final layer, which semantic detectors read, the DINOv3 class token barely separates real from generated images (mean AUROC 0.52 [0.50, 0.54] ; Figure 2 a). At layers 10–16 it does (0.74–0.78; layer 16: 0.78 [0.75, 0.80] ), a gain of 0.26 [0.24, 0.28] over the final layer on the same images. DINOv2 shows the same shape at a lower level: 0.68 at layer 14, and 0.38 at its final layer, which is below chance. Chameleon follows the same curve (DINOv3 layer 16: 0.78 [0.74, 0.81] ; final layer 0.63; Figure 2 b). The full curves agree with the 470-image pilot from which Déjà VAE’s layers 8–18 were chosen: for DINOv3, which Déjà VAE uses, no layer outside that range is better on either benchmark (for DINOv2 on Chameleon, layer 22 is marginally better, 0.73 against 0.72 at layer 14). The drop at the end of the network is not specific to self-supervised training. CLIP, trained to match images with captions, has the same shape on the same images and copies: 0.85 at layer 14 [0.84, 0.87] and 0.59 at its final layer, a drop of 0.26 [0.24, 0.28] , as large as DINOv3’s. Whatever their objective, the final layers of all three models discard most of the difference between an image and its copy, while intermediate layers keep it. We did not test a backbone trained with labels.

blocks.en: The signal is uneven across generators. blocks.en: Patch-level distances and PSNR reward images that are easy to reconstruct, whatever their origin. A blurred real image reconstructs well. When real images are blurred to the PSNR of their own copy, PSNR rates them as generated with AUROC 0.98 [0.97, 0.99] , and so does the DINOv3 patch mean at layer 2 (0.94; Figure 2 c). The intermediate class token does the opposite. It rates the blurred images as less generated than the originals (0.07–0.38 across layers 8–18 of both backbones; DINOv3 layer 16: 0.31 [0.28, 0.34] ). This is not neutral but inverted: blurring makes an image look more real to the score, so blurring a generated image could also hide it, a boundary we test in Section 8 . At the same time the class token separates a simulated fake R ⁡ ( x ) R(x) from x x almost perfectly (0.99). This resistance to blur is a property of DINO, not of intermediate layers in general. CLIP’s intermediate class token separates GenImage’s generated images better than DINOv3’s, by 0.075 [0.051, 0.098] at its best layer. But it also rates the blurred reals as generated: 0.83 [0.81, 0.86] at layer 12 and 0.73 [0.70, 0.76] at layer 14, reaching chance only from layer 16 on (0.53). Part of CLIP’s stronger signal is therefore a smoothness signal, and on Chameleon CLIP is weaker than DINOv3 (best layer 0.72 against 0.78). This is why Déjà VAE reads DINOv3, why it reads the class token of intermediate layers, and why its training rows include the blur-matched counterfactual: a detector built on PSNR or early patch tokens would, in part, be a sharpness detector. Patch distances also invert on GenImage’s 128-pixel BigGAN images (AUROC 0.04 at layer 16), which move much more under the copy than real photographs.

blocks.en: Figure 2 d changes only how the copy is made. A × 0.75 \times 0.75 downscale before the copy costs 0.03 AUROC on both backbones (DINOv3 − 0.032 -0.032 [-0.051, -0.016] ). Squashing the image to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , as SimLBR does before reading it, costs DINOv3 0.075 [-0.095, -0.055] . Most of this loss comes from the generator whose images are shrunk the most: Midjourney (1024 pixels, shrunk four-fold) falls from 0.99 to 0.73, while the 512-pixel SD generators lose at most 0.03. For DINOv2 the squash makes no measurable difference ( − 0.005 -0.005 [-0.025, 0.015] ). Re-saving both the view and its copy as JPEG q95 raises AUROC by 0.08 on both backbones, presumably because it removes fine detail in which every copy differs from its original. Resizing changes the image’s pixel grid, so a strongly resized image is no longer the decoder’s own output. This is why Déjà VAE copies a native-resolution crop.

blocks.en: Without training, the fixed point is visible to frozen foundation models, self-supervised or trained on image–text pairs, mainly in their intermediate layers; a head trained on copies can still read a difference at the final layer ( Appendix E ). In DINO these layers do not mistake smoothness for generation, while in CLIP they partly do. The signal survives mild downscaling but not strong downscaling.

blocks.en: Question: is the déjà vu a property of latent diffusion in general, or of the exact decoder that produced the image?
blocks.zh: 问题:déjà viv是一般潜在扩散的财产,还是产生图像的确切解码器的财产?

blocks.en: If a generated image is a near fixed point of its generator’s autoencoder, the trace should be strongest under that exact decoder and weaker under any other, even a near-identical one. We test this without any learned head. Each image and its matched real are copied with every autoencoder in a bank, and each copy is scored by the training-free signal of Section 3.1 . The clean test is Synthbuster, where every generated image comes from a known generator, real and generated images are stored losslessly, and their sizes match image by image ( Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 如果生成的图像是其生成器自动编码器的近乎固定的点,那么在精确的解码器下应该有更强的踪迹,在任何其他的,甚至近同同同的一面下也应该有更弱的踪迹. 我们测试这个时没有学过的东西 每个图像及其对应的真相被复制到银行的每个自动编码器,每个副本被第3.1节的无训练信号所打分. 干净的测试是合成器(Synthbuster),每个生成的图像都来自已知的生成器,真实和生成的图像被无所不存地存储,其大小以图像相匹配(第3.4节.

blocks.en: Synthbuster’s generators span every case our analysis distinguishes. Stable Diffusion 2 decodes with exactly the autoencoder Déjà VAE uses (ft-MSE). Stable Diffusion 1.3 and 1.4 share its encoder but decode with SD1’s original decoder, from which ft-MSE was fine-tuned. SDXL ( Podell et al., 2024 ) has its own autoencoder; our bank holds the version distributed as stabilityai/sdxl-vae . DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 decodes Stable Diffusion’s latent space with its own diffusion decoder, distilled to two steps with consistency distillation ( Betker et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 , App. B) ; OpenAI has released this decoder. DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2 ( Ramesh et al., 2022 ) and GLIDE ( Nichol et al., 2022 ) generate in pixel space and have no autoencoder. For Midjourney v5 and Adobe Firefly the architecture is not public.
blocks.zh: 合成器的发电机遍及每个案例, Stable Divusion 2解码,精确地使用自动编码器Déjà VAE(ft-MSE). 稳定分解 1.3和1.4与SD1的原始分解器共享其编码器但解码器,从中ft-MSE被微调出. SDXL(Podell等,2024年)拥有自己的自编码器;我们的银行持有以squistai/sdxl-vae发售的版本. DALL \\cdot E 3用自身的扩散解码器解码出稳定分化器的潜在空间,蒸馏为两步并有一致性分解(Betker等,2023;Song等,2023;App.B);OpenAI已放出此解码器. DALL \\cdot E2(Ramesh等,2022年)和GLIDE(Nichol等,2022年)在像素空间中生成,没有自发编码器. 对于Midjourney v5和Adobe Firefly来说,建筑并不公开.

blocks.en: Copying each generator’s images with its own decoder should give the strongest training-free signal: SD1’s original decoder for SD 1.3 and 1.4, ft-MSE for SD 2, SDXL’s autoencoder for SDXL, and the released consistency decoder for DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3. In particular, DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 should show a strong signal under the consistency decoder and a weak one under ft-MSE and SD1’s decoder, although all three share the same encoder. We cannot verify that the DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 service used to build Synthbuster runs exactly the released decoder.
blocks.zh: 用自己的解码器复制每个发电机的图像,应发出最强的无训练信号: SD1最初为SD 1.3和1.4的解码器,Ft-MSE为SD 2,SDXL的自定义编码器为SDXL,而DALL \\cdot E 3的已放出的一致性解码器为-. 特别是,DALL \\cdot E 3应该在一致性解码器下显示强烈信号,在ft-MSE和SD1的解码器下显示弱信号,尽管这三种都具有相同的编码器. 我们无法证实用于构建合成器的 DALL \\\cdot E 3 服务 运行的是释放的解码器 。

blocks.en: The bank holds SD1’s original decoder, ft-MSE, SDXL, Kandinsky’s MoVQ, a FLUX-family autoencoder, DC-AE and the consistency decoder ( Appendix A ). For each generator we copy 200 generated images and their 200 matched test reals with every autoencoder, without the JPEG re-save, and score each copy by how little the DINOv3 class token moves (z-scored on the real images, layers 10–18). The threshold is set in-sample, at the 95th percentile of the generator’s own 200 matched reals. Because real and generated images have the same sizes, resolution cannot produce a signal here.
blocks.zh: 银行持有SD1最初的解码器,ft-MSE,SDXL,Kandinsky的MoVQ,一个FLUX-家族自编码器,DC-AE和一致性解码器(附录A). 对每个生成器,我们复制200个生成的图像及其200个与每个自动编码器匹配的测试真能,而不需要JPEG重新保存,并且根据DINov3类符号动作(在真实图像上评分为Z分数,第10至18层)对每个复制件进行分分。 这个阈值是用例数设定的,在发电机本身的200个相匹配的活性值中,是95个百分点。 由于真实和生成的图像大小相同,分辨率不能在这里产生信号.

Top: reals downscaled to each generated image’s size (pre-specified). Bottom: the same generated images against cropped reals ( Section 3.4 ), for the five generators with a pre-specified decoder. TPR (%) at 5% FPR of the fixed-point score (DINOv3 class token, layers 10–18) under each autoencoder; the threshold is the 95th percentile of the generator’s own matched reals. Bold: the generator’s own decoder as pre-specified. † Added post hoc, after the SDXL prediction failed; underlined: the SDXL version Synthbuster’s images match. SD1: SD1’s original decoder; MoVQ: Kandinsky 2.1; Cons.: OpenAI’s consistency decoder. With 200 images per cell, a 95% binomial interval spans at most ± 7 \pm 7 points.
blocks.zh: 表1:合成器上的解码器库(无培训;200个生成的图像及其200个匹配的每个生成器的测试真能,没有再保存). 上: 真实缩放到每个生成的图像大小( 预先指定) 。 底部:用预先指定的解码器制作的五台发电机的同一种图像。 每个自动编码器下的固定分数(DINOv3等号,第10至18层)的分数(5分FPR)为TPR (%); 阈值是发电机自身对应真实值的第95分之一。 粗体:发电机本身的解码器是预先指定的. 在 SDXL 预测失败后添加后临时; 下划线: SDXL 版本合成器的图像匹配 。 SD1:SD1最初的解码器;MOVQ:Kandinsky 2.1;Cons:OpenAI的一致解码器. 每个单元格有200个图像,95%的二相间隔最长为±7\pm 7分.

blocks.en: With downscaled reals ( Table 1 , top), SD1’s original decoder detects 99.5% of SD 1.3 and 99.0% of SD 1.4 images, while ft-MSE, which shares its encoder, detects 21–26%. ft-MSE detects 95.0% of SD 2 images, and no other autoencoder more than 41%. When each image is attributed to the autoencoder under which it moves least, 100%, 98.5% and 94.5% of these images go to their own decoder.
blocks.zh: SD1最初的解码器探测到99.5%的SD 1.3和99.0%的SD 1.4图像,而共享其解码器的Ft-MSE探测到21–26. ft-MSE探测到95.0%的SD 2图像,其他自发编码器不超过41%. 当每个图像被归结为它移动最少的自编码器时,这些图像的100%,98.5%和94.5%都归到自己的解码器上.

blocks.en: The SDXL prediction fails as specified: the SDXL autoencoder in our bank detects 7.0% of SDXL images, and no autoencoder more than 12%. We then looked for the cause, so what follows is post hoc. Synthbuster’s generation parameters name samplers from Stability AI’s own code base, which decodes with the autoencoder stored in the model checkpoint. The official SDXL 1.0 repository ships two versions of the autoencoder, in folders named vae and vae_1_0 ; ours is bit-identical to the first, and the weights of the two differ only slightly ( Appendix A ). With the second version, the fixed-point score detects 100% of Synthbuster’s SDXL images (AUROC 1.000) and attributes 99.5% of them to it, while it detects at most 23.5% of any other generator’s images. Two versions of one autoencoder thus detect 7% and 100% of the same images; we add the second version to the bank, so that it holds eight autoencoders.
blocks.zh: SDXL预测失败如所指定:我们银行的SDXL自编码器检测出7.0%的SDXL图像,没有超过12%的自编码器. 然后我们寻找事业,所以接下来是临时的。 Synthbuster的生成参数取自稳定AI自身代码基础的样本器,该代码与存储在模型检查站的自动编码器解码. 官方的SDXL 1.0寄存器上载了两个版本的自定义编码器,在以vae和vae_1_0为名的文件夹中;我们的编码与第一个编码是比特-等同的,两个编码的重量只略有不同(附录A.). 使用第二版,定点分数检测合成器SDXL图像的100%(AUROC 1.000),并将其中99.5%的图像归属于它,同时它检测到最多23.5%的任何其他生成器图像. 一个自动编码器的两个版本可以检测到7%和100%的同一种图像;我们把第二个版本添加到银行,这样它就持有了8个自动编码器.

blocks.en: The DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 prediction holds only nominally: the consistency decoder gives the highest TPR in its row (34.5%, against 32.5% for ft-MSE and FLUX), but by AUROC it is behind three other autoencoders. This decoder adds noise at each of its two steps, so even the exact decoder cannot return an image to itself; this may explain the weak signal, but we have not tested it. No autoencoder approaches the matched levels on the pixel-space generators (at most 44%) or on Firefly (at most 8.5%). Midjourney v5 behaves like an ft-MSE image (91.0%), as GenImage’s Midjourney does; we do not know its architecture and draw no conclusion ( Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: DALL \\cdot E 3 预测仅名义上持有:一致性解码器给出了行中最高的TPR(34.5%,而ft-MSE和FLUX为32.5%),但通过AUROC它却落后于另外三个自动编码器. 这个解码器在它的两步中每一步都增加了噪音,所以即使精确的解码器也无法将一个图像还给自己;这也许可以解释弱信号,但我们还没有测试过. 在像素空间发电机(最多为44%)或萤火虫(最多为8.5%。 Midjourney v5的行为就像一个ft-MSE图像(91.0%),就像GenImage的Midjourney一样;我们不知道它的架构,也没有得出任何结论(附录F).

blocks.en: With cropped reals ( Table 1 , bottom), the exact decoder remains the strongest autoencoder for all four Stable Diffusion versions: it detects 100% of SD 1.3 and 1.4 images, 94.5% of SD 2 and 100% of SDXL. Native-resolution crops of camera photographs change more under every autoencoder than downscaled ones, so the other autoencoders detect more: the near-identical versions 16.5–42.0%, and unrelated autoencoders up to 81.0% (SDXL’s on SD 2). We therefore measure specificity as the exact decoder’s AUROC margin over the best other autoencoder, re-chosen in every bootstrap draw. The margin is 0.15–0.34 with downscaled reals and 0.03–0.24 with cropped reals, and its 95% interval excludes zero for all four generators under both matchings; the smallest is SD 2 with cropped reals, 0.030 [0.016, 0.049] . With cropped reals the DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 prediction fails outright ( Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 以被收割的真相(表1,下部),精确的解码器仍然是所有四个"稳定扩散"版本最强的自编码器:它检测到100%的SD 1.3和1.4图像,94.5%的SD 2和100%的SDXL. 相机相机相机的原生分辨率收成在每台自定义相机下的变化比被缩小的相机要多,因此其他自定义相机更能检测:近同版本16.5–42.0%,无关自定义相机高达81.0%(SDXL's on SD 2). 因此,我们用精确的解码器的AUROC比其他最佳自定义器的比值来测量具体性,在每一个靴子上重新选择。 差值为0.15-0.34,降级为实数,0.03-0.24为收成为实数,其95%的间隔排除了所有四台发电机在两种相配情况下的零;最小的是SD 2为收成为实数,0.030 [0.016,0.049]. 直接失败(附录F)。

blocks.en: GenImage cannot give as clean a test, because its real images are JPEG and its generated images PNG; copied as stored, the JPEG reals move more under every autoencoder, so we re-save every view as JPEG q95 before the copy ( Appendix G ). SD1’s original decoder is then still the best single autoencoder for SD 1.4, SD 1.5 and Wukong (66% of the 600 images pooled, against 52% for ft-MSE), but the margin is small, and the re-save itself perturbs the decoder’s output, so GenImage supports the account only weakly. No autoencoder in the bank matches Chameleon, whose real and generated images are both mostly JPEG at quality 75 ( Section 9 ): the best single one (DC-AE) detects 37%, the bank maximum 34%, and the SDXL version that matches Synthbuster exactly 16%.
blocks.zh: GenImage不能作为干净的测试给出,因为其真实的图像是JPEG及其生成的图像PNG;被复制为存储,JPEG的活性在每一个自编码器下移动得更多,因此我们在复制前(附录G.)将每个视图重新保存为JPEG q95. SD1最初的解码器仍然是SD 1.4,SD 1.5和Wukong(600个图像集合的66%,而Ft-MSE为52%)最好的单自编码器,但比值很小,再自保会干扰解码器的输出,因此GenImage只支持了账户. 银行内没有自动编码器匹配Chameleon,其真实和生成的图像在质量75分(第9节)时都大多是JPEG:最好的单机(DC-AE)检测出37%,银行最大34%,SDXL版本完全匹配合成器16%.

blocks.en: If the trace belongs to the exact decoder, a Déjà VAE trained on copies from SD1’s original decoder instead of ft-MSE should gain on SD1 images and lose where ft-MSE is the matched decoder. We wrote down four such predictions before training and retrained both variants with only the copy decoder changed (three seeds; Table 7 ). All four hold: on Synthbuster, SD 1.3 and 1.4 gain 5–8 points while SD 2, whose decoder is ft-MSE, loses about 2, and on GenImage, Midjourney, which ft-MSE matches best, loses 3–8 ( Appendix H ). The copy decoder also shifts whole benchmarks in opposite directions, so no single one is best everywhere; the rest of this paper uses ft-MSE, a choice made at the start of the study.
blocks.zh: 如果追踪属于精确的解码器,则从SD1的原始解码器而不是ft-MSE中培训的Déjà VAE应该从SD1的图像上获得,并在ft-MSE是匹配的解码器的地方丢失. 我们在训练前写下4个这样的预测,并重新训练两个变体,只有复制解码器改变了(3个种子;表7)。 所有四种控件:在合成器上,SD 1.3和1.4得到5-8分,而解码器为ft-MSE的SD 2则损失了约2分;在Ft-MSE最匹配的Genimage上,Midjourney则损失了3-8分(附录H ). 副本解码器也将整个基准向相反方向转移,因此,没有哪一个是各地最好的;本文其余部分使用ft-MSE,这是研究开始时作出的选择.

blocks.en: Where it can be tested cleanly, the training-free déjà vu is a property of the generator’s exact decoder. Under both ways of matching the real photographs, the generator’s own decoder separates the images of SD 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL from real photographs better than any of seven other autoencoders (for SDXL, after identifying its version post hoc). It detects 94–100% of them, while a near-identical version of the same autoencoder detects 7–42%. No autoencoder we tried matches web images.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 在两种匹配真实相片的方式下,生成器自己的解码器将SD 1.3,1.4,2和XL的相片与真实相片区分开来,比其他7个自动编码器中的任何一种都好(用于SDXL,在识别其版本后临时). 它探测到94-100%的它们,而同一种自编码器的近同版本探测到7-42%. 没有自动编码器, 我们尝试匹配网页图像 。

blocks.en: 6 Does a detector trained without fakes work?
blocks.zh: 6个 训练的探测器没有作假有用吗?

blocks.en: Question: can a detector that has never seen a generated image match detectors trained on thousands of them?
blocks.zh: 问:一个从未见过 被训练过数千个图像匹配探测器的探测器吗?

blocks.en: We planned Déjà VAE-P as the method and trained Déjà VAE-I from the start as its control, to test whether reading the copy helps. Both are reported everywhere. The text leads with Déjà VAE-I because it is the stronger zero-fake detector on GenImage. This choice was made after the GenImage results, but both variants were frozen before Synthbuster was scored, so Synthbuster ( Section 7 ) tests the choice on data it never saw; there, Déjà VAE-I’s lead over SimLBR depends on how the real photographs are matched. Déjà VAE-I detects 87.5% of GenImage fakes at a 5% false-positive rate ( Table 2 ). This is higher than the released SimLBR head, which was trained on 162k generated images (+2.3 points [0.9, 3.7] ), and much higher at the worst generator (64.2 vs. 45.0). It is above SimLBR retrained on 10k generated images (83.8), and above SimLBR trained on 1.25k generated images (72.1; Appendix I ). It needs no copy at test time, so it costs the same single DINOv3 pass as SimLBR (58 ms per image on our hardware; Appendix A ). Against the AlignedForensics-style reconstruction probe, which also uses no generated images, Déjà VAE-I gains 6.5 points [5.1, 8.1] on the mean and 13.3 [9.6, 16.9] at the worst generator, a difference in three factors at once: intermediate layers, native-resolution copies and counterfactual reals. Changing one factor at a time ( Appendix E ), the intermediate layers add 8.0 points on GenImage [6.5, 9.4] over the same head on the final layer, though not on Synthbuster, and the counterfactual rows mainly control false alarms. The same choices hurt on Chameleon, where the reconstruction probe, which reads squashed final-layer features, is 28.9 points [26.3, 31.5] ahead. Most of that gap is the layer: read at the final layer, Déjà VAE-I detects 61.2% of Chameleon’s generated images, close to the reconstruction probe’s 63.0% ( Table 2 , grey row; Section 7.1 ). Section 8 examines why the intermediate-layer trace does not survive web processing.
blocks.zh: 我们计划把Déjà VAE-P作为方法,并从一开始就训练Déjà VAE-I作为它的控制,以测试阅读副本是否有帮助. 这两种情况到处都有报道。 文本以Déjà VAE-I为首,因为它是GenImage上更强大的零假探测器. 这个选择是在GenImage结果之后作出的,但两个变体在Synthbuster被打出之前被冻结了,所以Synthbuster(第七节)测试了它从未见过的数据的选择;在那里,Déjà VAE-I在SimLBR上的领先取决于真实相片是如何匹配的. Déjà VAE-I检测出87.5%的基因组假冒率为5%的假阳性(表2)。 这比释放的SimLBR头要高,它接受了162克生成的图像(+2.3分[0.9,3.7])的训练,最差的生成器(64.2对45.0)要高得多. 它在SimLBR上方重新训练了10k生成的图像(83.8),在SimLBR上方训练了1.25k生成的图像(72.1;附录一. 它在测试时不需要复制,所以它花费与SimLBR(我们的硬件上每个图像58ms;附录A.)相同的单个DINOv3通过. 与同样没有使用所生成图像的AcontentForensics式重建探测器相比,Déjà VAE-I在平均值上得到6.5分[5.1,8.1],在最差的生成器上得到13.3分[9.6,16.9],这一次有三个因素的不同:中间层,本土分辨率副本和反事实真相. 一次改变一个因子(附录E),中间地层在GenImage [6.5, 9.4]上为最终地层上同一头上增加8.0分,虽然在合成器上没有,而反事实行主要控制假警报. 同样的选择也伤害了Chameleon,其中的重建探测器读取了被压扁的末层特征,其前方有28.9分[26.3, 31.5]. 大部分的空隙是地层:在最后一层读取,Déjà VAE-I检测到61.2%的变色龙生成的图像,接近重建探测器的63.0%(表2,灰行;第7.1节)。 第8节研究了中间层微量为何无法活过网络处理.

blocks.en: Déjà VAE-I exceeds RIGID by 55.4 points [53.4, 57.5] (48.9 [46.9, 50.9] with the stronger noise convention) and AEROBLADE, on its subset, by 28.6 [23.1, 35.0] . RIGID is near chance on latent diffusion images (6–8%), with or without the JPEG re-save ( Appendix B ). AEROBLADE reaches 71–84% on most generators but flags 48% of degraded real photographs, because a slightly blurred photograph reconstructs well; Déjà VAE-TF keeps that rate at 5.5%.
blocks.zh: Déjà VAE-I凭借更强烈的噪音公约,比RIGID多出55.4分 [53.4, 57.5] (48.9 [46.9, 50.9]),而AEROBLADE的子集则多出28.6分 [23.1, 35.0]. RIGID在潜在扩散图像(6-8%)上几乎是偶然的,无论有没有JPEG重新保存(附录B)。 在大多数发电机上,AEROBLADE达到了71-84%,但在退化的真实照片中,旗帜为48%,因为一张略为模糊的照片重建得很好;Déjà VAE-TF将这个比例保持在5.5%。

blocks.en: Removing the blur-matched counterfactual rows raises Déjà VAE-P’s TPR on GenImage by 8.6 points [8.0, 9.2] , but it buys that gain by flagging soft images. Without the counterfactual rows, Déjà VAE-P’s false alarms on degraded real photographs rise from 4.0% to 39.9% on GenImage and from 2.5% to 38.9% on Chameleon. The fused detector inherits the problem (20.6% and 25.8%, against 4.1% and 3.5%). For Déjà VAE-I the effect is smaller but has the same sign: from 5.0% to 29.8% on GenImage, 2.0% to 12.8% on Chameleon and 3.0% to 16.8% on Synthbuster ( Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 移除模糊相匹配的反事实行将Déjà VAE-P在GenImage上的TPR提升了8.6分[8.0, 9.2],但它通过标出软图像来购买这一收益. 没有反事实行,Déjà VAE-P在退化真实照片上的虚假警报在GenImage上从4.0%上升到39.9%,在Chameleon上从2.5%上升到38.9%。 引信探测器继承了这一问题(20.6%和25.8%,而4.1%和3.5%)。 对Déjà VAE-I来说,效果较小,但也有相同的标志:GenImage从5.0%到29.8%,Chameleon从2.0%到12.8%,合成器从3.0%到16.8%(附录E)。

blocks.en: Reading the copy alongside the image does not help on GenImage: Déjà VAE-P is 9.0 points [ − 10.1 -10.1 , − 7.9 -7.9 ] below Déjà VAE-I. On Chameleon the order reverses, and Déjà VAE-P is 15.1 points [12.9, 17.2] above Déjà VAE-I. On Synthbuster Déjà VAE-P is again behind, by 9.8 points (5.1 with cropped reals; Appendix F ). Déjà VAE-P reads how the image moved, and Déjà VAE-I only where it is. One plausible reading, which we have not tested, is that movement transfers better to the unknown generators and processing of web images, while position alone suffices on curated benchmarks. On Chameleon both variants are far below every detector trained with generated images.
blocks.zh: 在GenImage上读取影印本无济于事:Déjà VAE-P在Déjà VAE-I下方为9.0分[−10.1-10.1,−7.9-7.9]. 在Chameleon上,顺序倒转,而Déjà VAE-P在Déjà VAE-I上方的分数为15.1分[12.9,17.2]. On Synthbuster Déjà VAE-P又落后了9.8分(5.1分为收成活性;附录F.). Déjà VAE-P读出画面的动向,Déjà VAE-I仅在所处. 我们尚未测试的一个合理解读是,移动更好地转移到未知的发电机和网络图像的处理,而仅靠定位就足够了。 在变色龙上,两个变体都远远低于每个经过了生成图像训练的探测器.

blocks.en: Déjà VAE-I’s gains are largest on generators that decode through a Stable Diffusion autoencoder (99.1–99.5% on SD 1.4, SD 1.5 and Wukong). A matched decoder also helps the training-free scores: AEROBLADE detects 90% of SD 1.4 images with SD1’s original autoencoder and 33% with the fine-tuned one, and on Synthbuster the exact decoder separates the classes almost perfectly ( Section 5 ). GenImage’s ADM and BigGAN images are also detected (67% and 84%), but the fixed point does not explain this. BigGAN has no autoencoder and its images do not move less than real ones under the copy (AUROC 0.47 at layer 16; Section 4 ), and ADM’s training-free signal is weak (0.63). These detections come from other differences that the trained head picks up, and should not be read as evidence for the premise. On GenImage, resolution is one candidate; on Synthbuster, where resolution is matched, Déjà VAE-I still detects the pixel-space DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2 ( Section 7 ).
blocks.zh: Déjà VAE-I通过稳定分化自动编码器解码的发电机的收益最大(SD 1.4、SD 1.5和Wukong为99.1-99.5%)。 一个匹配的解码器也帮助了无训练分数:AEROBLADE用SD1的原始自编码器检测出90%的SD 1.4图像,用精细的编码器检测出33%,而在合成器上,精确的解码器几乎完美地将各个课程分开(第5节)。 GenImage的ADM和BigGAN图像也被检测出(67%和84%),但固定点并不能解释这一点. BigGAN没有自定义编码器,其图像的移动不小于副本下的真实编码(AUROC 0.47, 第16层; 第4节),ADM的无训练信号很弱(0.63). 这些检测来自被训练出的头所取出的其他差异,不应被解读为前提的证据. 在GenImage上,分辨率是一个候选;在同分辨率匹配的合成器上,Déjà VAE-I仍然检测到像素-空间 DALL \\\cdot E 2 (第7节).

blocks.en: When the image is unprocessed, a detector trained on real photographs and their copies matches a detector trained on 162k generated images on GenImage. On modern generators it is competitive, ahead or behind depending on how the real photographs are matched ( Section 7 ), and on web images it is far behind.
blocks.zh: 当图像未处理时,一个接受过真实相片及其拷贝培训的探测器与一个经过162克生成的GenImage图像培训的探测器相匹配. 在现代发电机上,视真实相片的配对情况而定(第7节),它具有竞争力,在前面或后面,在网络相片上则远远落后。

blocks.en: 7 Does the comparison hold without the size shortcut?
blocks.zh: 第7条 比较是否没有大小快捷键?

blocks.en: Question: on recent generators, evaluated so that size cannot separate the classes, how does a detector trained without generated images compare?
blocks.zh: 问题:在最近的发电机上,经过评估后,大小不能将类分开,没有生成图像的探测器如何比较?

blocks.en: GenImage’s generators are dated, and Chameleon cannot be evaluated without first removing a size shortcut ( Section 9 ). Synthbuster pairs every generated image with a real photograph of the same size, in two ways: downscaled, as pre-specified, and cropped at native resolution, added later ( Section 3.4 ). Detectors and heads are those of Section 6 , frozen before any Synthbuster image was scored; nothing is retrained. Every interval resamples RAISE photographs, because each contributes nine matched reals and up to nine generated images.
blocks.zh: Genimage 的发电机日期已过, 合成成对的每个生成的图像都带有同样大小的真实相片,有两种方式:被降级,作为预先指定的,以原生分辨率收成,后加(第3.4节. 探测器和头部是第6节的,在任何合成图像被打出之前被冻结;没有任何东西被重新训练。 每个间隔复制RAISE相片,因为每个相片都贡献出9个相匹配的真相和多达9个生成的相片.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Synthbuster with downscaled reals. (a) TPR at a 5% false-positive rate per generator, with one threshold per method and seed set on the pooled calibration reals. Rows are grouped by how each generator decodes; “our decoder” is the ft-MSE autoencoder that makes Déjà VAE’s copies. (b) False-positive rate at the same threshold on each generator’s matched test reals (nominal 5%). SD 2 and SDXL images have the same sizes image by image, so their matched reals are identical. Points: mean over three seeds; bars: 95% bootstrap intervals (calibration reals resampled by photograph; fakes and matched test reals resampled; B = 1,000 B=1{,}000 ). The same comparison with cropped reals is in Tables 3 and F .
blocks.zh: 图3:与被缩减的真能合成. (a) TPR按每台发电机5%的假阳性率计算,在集合校正实值上设定了每个方法和种子的一个阈值。 以每个生成器的解码方式组合行; " 我们的解码器 " 是制作 Déjà VAE 副本的ft-MSE 自动编码器。 (b) 在每个发电机的匹配测试实值上同一阈值的虚假阳性率(名义5%)。 SD 2和SDXL相片的相片相片相片大小相同,因此相片相配的真相片也完全相同. 点:指出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 表3和表F与所收现物作了同样的比较。

blocks.en: Table 3: Synthbuster under two ways of matching the real photographs. Downscaled (pre-specified): each RAISE photograph is cropped to the aspect ratio of its paired generated image and resized to its exact size. Cropped (added after the downscaled results): a native-resolution centre crop at the generated image’s exact size, with no resampling. Generated images, calibration/test split and detectors are identical. TPR (%) at 5% FPR, mean and worst over the nine generators, and false-positive rate (%) on the matched test reals at the same threshold; mean over 3 seeds. ‡ The first version of Déjà VAE-I, reading the final-layer class token, scored on Synthbuster post hoc ( Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 表3:结合真相两种方式下的合成. 缩放(预先指定):每张RAISE相片被裁剪到其成对生成的相片的外观比并被调整到精确大小. 已收割( 降尺度结果后添加): 原生分辨率中心作物, 按生成图像的精确大小, 没有再取样 。 生成的图像,校正/测试分解和探测器是相同的. TPR(百分比)为5%的FPR,在9个发电机中为平均值和最差,在相同阈值的匹配测试实数中为假阳性率;平均值为3个以上种子。 第一个版本的"Déjà VAE-I"读取了最终的等级符号,在Synthbuster post hot(附录E.)上得分.

blocks.en: With downscaled reals, Déjà VAE-I detects 84.5% of Synthbuster images at a 5% false-positive rate ( Table 2 ): 4.4 points above the released SimLBR head [1.9, 7.1] , 6.1 above the supervised probe [3.7, 8.5] and 14.6 above the reconstruction probe [11.4, 17.9] . The lead does not survive the second matching. With cropped reals Déjà VAE-I detects 68.2%, 9.7 points below SimLBR [ − 13.2 -13.2 , − 6.1 -6.1 ] and level with the supervised probe ( − 1.3 -1.3 [ − 5.1 -5.1 , 2.8] ), while SimLBR itself changes by 2.4 points ( Table 3 ). We therefore do not claim that Déjà VAE-I is better than SimLBR on Synthbuster. The two matchings differ in the pixel scale of the real photographs, and Déjà VAE-I is sensitive to it: on downscaled reals, the less a photograph was downscaled, the more generated it looks to Déjà VAE-I (Spearman ρ = − 0.12 \rho=-0.12 over the 4,491 test reals; SimLBR − 0.04 -0.04 ).
blocks.zh: Déjà VAE-I以5%的假阳性率探测出84.5%的合成图像(表2):在释放出SimLBR头部上方4.4分[1.9, 7.1],在被监督探测器上方6.1分[3.7, 8.5],在重建探测器上方[11.4, 17.9]. 领先无法活过第二次匹配. 所种植的真能Déjà VAE-I探测到68.2%,低于SimLBR的9.7分[−13.2-13.2,−6.1-6.1],与受监督探测器的平分(−1.3-1.3 [−5.1-5.1, 2.8]),而SimLBR本身则变化了2.4分(表3). 因此,我们不声称Déjà VAE-I比Synthbuster上的SimLBR更好. 两种相配在真实相片的像素尺度上有所不同,而Déjà VAE-I对相片很敏感:在被缩小的真相片上,相片被缩小的程度越小,其生成的对Déjà VAE-I的视线越多(Spearman à = − 0.12\rho=-0.12,相对于4,491个测试活相片;SimLBR − 0.04-0.04).

blocks.en: The per-generator pattern holds under both matchings ( Figure 3 a; intervals in Appendix F ). Déjà VAE-I is far ahead of SimLBR on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2 (+43.0 with downscaled and +30.9 with cropped reals), Firefly (+56.4 and +54.4) and SD 2 (+20.6 and +20.0), and far behind on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 ( − 37.2 -37.2 and − 73.5 -73.5 ) and GLIDE ( − 39.8 -39.8 and − 58.2 -58.2 ). The matching decides SD 1.3, SD 1.4, SDXL and Midjourney, where the two detectors are within 5 points with downscaled reals and Déjà VAE-I is 8–30 points behind with cropped reals. Two results constrain how the detector should be read. DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2 has no autoencoder, yet Déjà VAE-I detects 93.7% of its images (78.3% with cropped reals): the detector learns how real photographs respond to the copy and flags images that respond differently, whatever made them. And DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3, which shares SD 2’s latent space but has its own decoder, is detected at only 62.6% (26.1%): sharing the encoder is not enough.
blocks.zh: 每生成者模式在两种匹配下都保持(图3a;附录F中的间隔)。 Déjà VAE-I远领先于SimLBR的DALL \\cdot E2(+43.0,缩放平面;+30.9,收割地产);Firefly (+56.4和+54.4)和SD 2 (+20.6和+20.0),并远远落后于DALL \cdot E 3(-37.2-37.2和-73.5-73.5)和GLIDE(-39.8-39.8和-58.2-58.2)。 相配决定了SD 1.3,SD 1.4,SDXL和Midjourney,这两个探测器在5分以内有被缩小的真能,而Déjà VAE-I与被收割的真能相比落后了8-30分. 两个结果制约了检测器应如何被读取. DALL \\cdot E 2 没有自动编码器, 然而Déjà VAE-I检测到其93.7%的图像(78.3%为被收割的真品): 探测器学习真实相片如何响应副本, DALL \\cdot E 3 共享SD 2 的潜在空间但有自己的解码器, 检测到的只有62.6%(26.1%):共享编码器是不够的。

blocks.en: One pooled threshold transfers across generator geometries. With downscaled reals, every detector’s false-positive rate lies between 3.1% and 8.0% on each generator’s matched test reals ( Figure 3 b), except Déjà VAE-I on the reals matched to Firefly, the least downscaled photographs (14.6%). The Firefly gain does not depend on this: with a threshold set on those reals, Déjà VAE-I detects 93.7% of Firefly images and SimLBR 40.4%. With cropped reals, Déjà VAE sees the same view for all nine reals of a photograph, so its false-positive rate is the same for every generator (Déjà VAE-I 7.3%, Déjà VAE-P 5.0%; SimLBR 3.6–9.0%), and rests on 499 distinct test photographs. On degraded real images Déjà VAE-I flags 3.0% and SimLBR 4.5%.
blocks.zh: 一次通过发电机地理计量的集合阈值转移。 每台探测器的假阳性率在每台发电机的测试真能值上为3.1%至8.0%(图3b),但与"萤火"相匹配的真能值上的Déjà VAE-I除外,这是最小的缩放照片(14.6%)。 萤火虫增益并不取决于此:在设定了这些真能的阈值后,Déjà VAE-I检测到萤火虫图像的93.7%和SimLBR40.4%. Déjà VAE对9个真实照片都持同样看法,因此每台发电机的假阳性率都相同(Déjà VAE-I 7.3%,Déjà VAE-P 5.0%;SimLBR 3.6– 9.0%),并以499个不同的测试相片为依据。 在退化的真实图像上,Déjà VAE-I标出3.0%和SimLBR标出4.5%.

blocks.en: 7.1 A head on the final layer
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 最后一层有一个头

blocks.en: The matching sensitivity belongs to the intermediate layers. The study’s first version of Déjà VAE-I, identical except that its head reads the final-layer class token ( Section 3.1 ), was scored on Synthbuster post hoc (grey rows in Tables 2 and 3 ). It detects 85.7% with downscaled and 86.3% with cropped reals, against 84.5% and 68.2% for layers 8–18; a linear head shows the same contrast (final layer 88.8–90.4% under both matchings; layers 8–18 falling from 85.6% to 52.4%; Appendix E ). It flags slightly more matched test reals than SimLBR (7.4% and 6.4%, against 5.6% and 5.3%). At equal false-positive rates, with every threshold set on the matched test reals, it is still ahead, by 3.6 points [0.3, 6.4] with downscaled and 7.2 [4.7, 10.2] with cropped reals (AUROC + 0.013 +0.013 and + 0.036 +0.036 , both intervals above zero).
blocks.zh: 相匹配的敏感性属于中间层. 研究的第一个版本Déjà VAE-I, 除了头部读取了最终的等级符号(第3.1节)之外, 是在合成后临时(表2和表3中的灰色行)上得分的。 它检测到85.7%的降尺度和86.3%的收成,而8至18层为84.5%和68.2%;线性头部显示的对比相同(两个配对下为88.8至90.4%;8至18层从85.6%下降到52.4%;附录E)。 与SimLBR(7.4%和6.4%,5.6%和5.3%)相比,它显示的测试真实性略高。 按等同的假阳性率,每个阈值被设定在相匹配的测试真值上,它仍然领先,降分为3.6分[0.3, 6.4],收分为7.2分[4.7, 10.2],收分为收分真值(AUROC + 0.013 + 0.013和 + 0.036 + 0.036,间隔均高于0).

blocks.en: It is not a better detector overall. It is behind SimLBR on GenImage (79.5%) and Chameleon (61.2%, though far ahead of Déjà VAE-I’s 33.9%), and less tied to the copy decoder (SD 2: 86.7% instead of 98.8%). Measured from each head’s clean score under the processing of Section 8 , it loses less to resizing and blur (a mild blur: − 15.5 -15.5 points against − 26.8 -26.8 ; a downscale with JPEG q75: − 14.5 -14.5 against − 22.5 -22.5 ), and its false alarms on processed reals stay at 2.2–8.0% (6.6–18.6%). A JPEG q75 re-save alone, however, costs it 15.0 points (9.7). It reads a more generic difference, less sensitive to how real photographs are resampled but not to compression, which we have not identified. Because it is post hoc on Synthbuster, we do not promote it to the main comparison.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,它不是一个更好的探测器。 在GenImage(79.5%)和Chameleon(61.2%,尽管远远领先于Déjà VAE-I的33.9%)上,它落后于SimLBR(SD 2:86.7%,而不是98.8%)的复制解码器。 从第8节的处理中,从每个头的干净分数中测出,它损失较少的是调整大小和模糊度(一个轻微的模糊度: - 15.5 - 15.5分对− 26.8 - 26.8分; 降级为JPEG q75: - 14.5 - 14.5分对− 22.5 - 22.5分),以及它在所处理的实物上的虚假警报停留在2.2 - 8.0%(6.6 - 18.6分)。 然而,单是JPEG q75就花费了15.0分(9.7分)。 它读取了比较通俗的区别,对真实相片如何被重印不太敏感,但对压缩并不敏感,我们还没有确定这一点. 因为它是Synthbuster专辑的专辑,我们不推广它与主比较.

blocks.en: With size removed as a cue, how the real photographs are matched to the generated images decides whether a detector trained on real photographs and their copies leads or trails one trained on 162k generated images ( + 4.4 +4.4 or − 9.7 -9.7 points). The sensitivity belongs to the intermediate layers: read at the final layer (post hoc), the same detector is ahead under both matchings. Under both, it is far ahead on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2, Firefly and SD 2 and far behind on GLIDE and DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3.
blocks.zh: 将大小去掉作为提示,真实照片如何与生成的图像相匹配,从而决定接受过真实照片培训的探测器及其复制品是否引导或跟踪162克生成的图像(+4.4+4.4或-9.7-9.7分)。 灵敏度属于中间地层:在最后地层(后临时地层)读取,在两个相配下,同一探测器在前. 在这两起事件中,DALL \cdot E 2,萤火虫和SD 2上远领先,而GLIDE和DALL \cdot E 3.上远落后.

blocks.en: 8 What breaks the déjà vu?
blocks.zh: 第8条 是什么打破了Déjà ve?

blocks.en: Question: why does a detector that matches SimLBR on GenImage fall to 34–49% on Chameleon?
blocks.zh: 问:为什么一个在GenImage上与SimLBR相匹配的探测器在变色龙上跌到34-49%?

blocks.en: Two explanations fit the premise. Web images may come from generators whose autoencoders Déjà VAE does not cover; no autoencoder in our bank matches Chameleon ( Section 5 ). And images on the web are resized and re-compressed after generation, which moves them off the autoencoder’s fixed point. Here we test the second.
blocks.zh: 两种解释符合前提。 网络图像可能来自自动编码器Déjà VAE不覆盖的发电机;我们的银行中没有自动编码器与Chameleon相匹配(第5节)。 而网络上的图像则会经过再世代的调整和再压缩,从而把它们从自定义器的固定点上移出. 在这里,我们测试第二个。

blocks.en: We take 150 fakes each from SD 1.4, Wukong and Midjourney, plus 300 real GenImage images, and apply one post-processing step to every image before the standard pipeline: a resize by × 0.5 \times 0.5 , × 0.75 \times 0.75 or × 1.5 \times 1.5 , a JPEG re-save at quality 75, or a × 0.75 \times 0.75 resize followed by JPEG q75. We recompute each detector’s threshold on reals processed the same way, and we also report the false-positive rate on processed reals if the threshold is left where it was.
blocks.zh: 我们从SD 1.4,Wukong和Midjourney各取出150个假相,加上300个真实的Genimage图像,并在标准管道之前对每个图像应用一个后处理步骤:调整大小为 × 0.5\tims 0.5, × 0.75\tims 0.75 或 × 1.5\tims 1.5, JPEG 质量为 75 重新保存,或 × 0.75\tims 0.75再调整大小为 JPEG q75 . 我们重新计算每个探测器在真实处理过的阈值, 如果阈值留在原地, 我们还报告在真实处理过的假阳性率。

blocks.en: On clean images Déjà VAE-P detects 97.4% of these fakes, against 90.0% for SimLBR ( Figure 4 ). Mild processing barely matters: a × 0.75 \times 0.75 resize costs Déjà VAE-P 2.7 points. Stronger processing does. A × 1.5 \times 1.5 upscale costs 24.5 points, and a × 0.75 \times 0.75 resize followed by JPEG q75 costs 19.0 (Déjà VAE-I: 22.5). SimLBR stays between 87.3% and 91.8% under every condition. Processing also shifts the score distribution of real images. If the threshold is left at its unprocessed value, JPEG q75 real photographs are flagged at 14.9–18.6% instead of 5%, while SimLBR stays at 3.7–5.7%.
blocks.zh: 在清洁图像上,Déjà VAE-P检测到这些假象的97.4%,而SimLBR检测到90.0%(图4)。 平分处理无关紧要:一×0.75\times 0.75 调整大小需要Déjà VAE-P 2.7分. 更强的处理。 A × 1.5\时 1.5 升分成本 24.5分,而 × 0.75\时 0.75再调整大小 JPEG q75 成本 19.0 (Déjà VAE-I: 22.5). SimLBR在每种情况下停留在87.3%至91.8%之间. 处理也会改变真实图像的分数分布. 如果阈值为未加工值,JPEG q75真实相片标出为14.9-18.6%而非5%,而SimLBR则标出为3.7-5.7%.

blocks.en: Chameleon shows the same pattern in the wild. Its fakes whose sides are not multiples of 8 pixels have almost certainly been resized after generation. Déjà VAE-P detects 42% of these, against 75% of the fakes whose sides are both multiples of 64, which look like untouched generator output. SimLBR barely changes between the two groups (83% vs. 87%).
blocks.zh: 变色龙在野外呈现出相同的图案. 它的假象的侧面不是8像素的倍数,几乎肯定在一代后被调整了尺寸. Déjà VAE-P 检测到其中的42%,而75%的假相,其侧面有64个倍数,看起来像是未触动的生成器输出. 辛语 LBR在两种群体之间几乎没有变化(83%对87%).

blocks.en: A mild blur is enough. Blurring generated images with the same Gaussian blur as our degraded real images ( σ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.5 , 1.5 ) \sigma\sim\mathcal{U}(0.5,1.5) ), with the threshold left where the calibration reals put it, lowers Déjà VAE-I from 87.9% to 61.1% and Déjà VAE-P from 78.1% to 55.6% on 1,600 GenImage fakes, but SimLBR only from 85.8% to 77.7%. This is the other side of the blur inversion of Section 4 : the score that refuses to call a blurred real image generated also lets a blurred generated image pass.
blocks.zh: 轻度模糊就够了 模糊生成的图像与我们退化的真实图像相同高斯文模糊(\\\ U(0.5, 1.5)\sigma\sim\mathcal{U}(0.5, 1.5)), 校正真实值所在的阈值, Déjà VAE-I从87.9%降至61.1%, Déjà VAE-P 从78.1%降至55.6%, 但SimLBR只从85.8%降至77.7%。 这是第4节模糊倒置的另一面:拒绝称模糊真实图像生成的分数也让模糊生成的图像通过.

blocks.en: Retraining Déjà VAE with every training row randomly resized and re-compressed recovers part of the loss on the controlled grid ( × 1.5 \times 1.5 : 72.9% → \to 85.3%), but not on Chameleon (48.1% vs. 49.2%), and it makes the detector more sensitive to processing itself: at a fixed threshold, false alarms on resized real images roughly double ( Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 重新训练Déjà VAE与每个训练行随机调整大小并重新压缩后,恢复了控制网格上的部分损失(×1.5\times 1.5:72.9%_=85.3%),但不在变色龙上(48.1%对49.2%),它使探测器对处理本身更为敏感:在固定阈值时,重新调整的真像上的假警报大约是双倍(附录D)。

blocks.en: Part of Déjà VAE-I’s Chameleon gap is the choice of layers rather than processing: read at the final layer, it detects 61.2% of Chameleon’s generated images instead of 33.9%, and resized and untouched ones alike, but that head is not robust to compression either ( Section 7.1 ). An unmatched decoder does not explain the gap away: no autoencoder in our bank restores the training-free signal on Chameleon ( Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: Déjà VAE-I's Chameleon 差距的一部分是选择地层而不是处理:在最后一层中读取,它检测出61.2%的Chameleon生成的图像而不是33.9%,并且大小和未变的都一样,但头部也无法被压缩(第7.1节)。 无法匹配的解码器并不能解释差距的去向:我们银行没有自动编码器恢复了Chameleon上的无训练信号(第5节.

blocks.en: The déjà vu is a property of the generator’s raw output. One resize with re-compression, or a mild blur, costs the trained detectors 19–27 points, while a semantic detector loses at most 8, and the processing-aware training we tried restores the trace only for the processing it was trained on.
blocks.zh: déjà vu是发电机的生產地產. 用再压缩或轻度模糊的再调整一次,使训练有素的探测器损失了19至27分,而一个语义探测器最多损失了8分,而我们试图恢复的处理-意识训练只用于它所训练的处理。

blocks.en: 9 Is the in-the-wild benchmark measuring what we think?
blocks.zh: 第9条 我们所想的值是多少?

blocks.en: Question: how much of a detector’s Chameleon score reflects generation, and how much reflects how the benchmark’s files were made?
blocks.zh: 问:探测器的变色龙分数多少反映出出世代,多少反映出基准文件是如何形成的?

blocks.en: While grouping Chameleon images by size for Section 8 , we found that every one of its 14,863 real images is exactly 500 pixels wide, while only 1 of its 11,170 generated images is ( Figure 5 a). The rule “width ≠ \neq 500 ⇒ \Rightarrow generated” detects 99.99% of the fakes with no false positives, without reading a single pixel. The released real images also do not match the benchmark’s description. Yan et al. (2025) describe Chameleon as ranging “from 720P to 4K” and state that images smaller than 448 × 448 448\times 448 were discarded. Yet no released real image has a short side of 720 pixels or more, and 57.3% have a short side below 448 pixels; the corresponding figures for the generated images are 48.6% and 6.7%. This is consistent with the real images having been saved as fixed-width previews rather than as originals, but we cannot verify how the files were produced. We shared these observations with the authors before releasing this work. The real images also share every other file property we checked: all are baseline JPEG at quality 75 with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling and no EXIF data. Most fakes are JPEG at quality 75 too, so compression is not the giveaway (format and JPEG table alone: AUROC 0.535). Geometry is: width, height and aspect ratio each separate the classes (AUROC 1.000, 1.000 and 0.887; real images are mostly landscape, with median height/width 0.72 against 1.5 for the fakes).
blocks.zh: 在将变色龙图像按尺寸分组到第8节时,我们发现其14,863个真实图像中,每个图像都正好有500像素宽度,而其11,170个生成的图像中只有1个是(图5a)。 规则“width \\\ neq 500\\ 右旋生成”检测到99.99%的假货没有假阳性,没有读取一个像素。 释放出的真实图像也不符合基准描述. 颜等. (2025年)将变色龙描述为从"从720P到4K",并声明小于448×448 448\times 448的图像被丢弃. 然而,没有释放出的真实图像有720像素或更短的一面,57.3%的图像有448像素以下的一面;生成的图像的相应数字为48.6%和6.7%。 这与真实的图像被保存为固定宽度预览而非正本一致,但我们无法核实文件是如何产生的. 在发表这部作品之前,我们与提交人分享了这些意见。 真实的图像还分享了我们检查过的所有其他文件属性:所有图像都是质量为75的基线JPEG,4:2:0的铬分样本,没有EXIF数据. 大部分的假相也是质量为75的JPEG,因此压缩不是放出(格式和JPEG表单:AUROC 0.535. 几何学是:宽度,高度和相距之比各分出类(AUROC 1.000, 1.000和0.887;真实图像多为地貌,相距相距为中高/相距0.72,相距为假相为1.5).

blocks.en: To measure how much detectors depend on this, we build a version of Chameleon in which size carries no information. Each fake is given the geometry of a randomly drawn real image. It is centre-cropped to that image’s aspect ratio, resized to exactly 500 × H 500\times H pixels, and saved as baseline JPEG at quality 75 with 4:2:0 subsampling and no metadata. Real images are untouched. Metadata classifiers fall to chance on every geometric feature ( Figure 5 b). The only remaining cue is bytes per pixel (AUROC 0.62), which depends on image content and which we keep.
blocks.zh: 为了测量探测器依赖于这个数据的数量, 我们构建了一个变色龙的版本, 其中大小没有信息。 每个假相都得到随机绘制出真实图像的几何. 它与该图像的外观比成正比, 大小调整到500×H 500\times H像素, 并保存为基线 JPEG, 质量为75: 2: 0 分样, 没有元数据 。 真实的图像没有被破坏. 元数据分类器在每个几何特征上都是偶然的(图5b)。 剩下的唯一提示是每个像素的字节(AUROC 0.62),这取决于图像内容,我们保存着.

blocks.en: Size matching changes two things at once: it removes the shortcut, and it adds a resize and a JPEG re-save to every fake. Our own results in Section 8 show that processing alone hurts detectors. We therefore add a processing-only control : each fake receives the same resize factor and the same JPEG re-save as in the size-matched set, but keeps its own aspect ratio and full content. The three versions share every real image and every fake identity, so per-detector differences are paired. Original minus control is the cost of processing; control minus size-matched is the cost of losing the shortcut. The size-matched fakes are also centre-cropped (66% of the image area kept, median), so the second difference also includes the loss of content and the change of aspect ratio.
blocks.zh: 大小匹配会同时改变两件事:它会去掉快捷键,它会在每个假件上添加一个变相大小和一个JPEG再保存. 我们自己在第8节的结果显示,单是处理会伤害探测器. 因此,我们增加一个只处理的控制 : 每个假件得到相同的调整因子, 和大小匹配的套件一样的 JPEG 重新保存, 但保持自己的外观比和完整内容 。 三个版本都分享每个真实的图像和每个假身份,因此每个检测者的差异都是对等的. 原始减控是处理成本;控制减大小匹配是丢失快捷键的成本. 大小相配的假相也由中-相接(所保存的图像区域的66%,中位数)而来,所以第二个差异还包括内容的丢失和侧相比的变化.

blocks.en:
Every detector loses ground on size-matched Chameleon (SimLBR 84.0% → \to 75.8%, Déjà VAE-P 49.2% → \to 37.6%, RIGID-DINOv3 29.5% → \to 15.0%). The decomposition in Figure 9 shows where the loss comes from. One extra resize and JPEG re-save costs SimLBR 5.8 points [5.3, 6.3] , the supervised probe 6.5, Déjà VAE-P 11.0 and RIGID 10.9. Removing the shortcut costs SimLBR 2.4 points [1.9, 3.0] and RIGID 3.6, and costs the supervised probe and both Déjà VAE variants less than one point. For the reconstruction probe it is negative ( − 2.6 -2.6 ): the reconstruction probe does slightly better without the shortcut.
Enlarged fakes do not explain these results: SimLBR detects fewer of the 38% of size-matched fakes that had to be upscaled than of the downscaled ones (72% vs. 78%).
blocks.zh:
每个探测器都会在大小相配的变色龙上失去地(SimLBR 84.0% ~\到75.8%,Déjà VAE-P 49.2% ~\到37.6%,RIGID-DINOv3 29.5% ~\到15.0%). 图9中的分解显示了损失的来源。 1个额外改型和JPEG重新保有成本SimLBR 5.8分[5.3, 6.3],被监督探测器 6.5, Déjà VAE-P 11.0和RIGID 10.9. 移除快捷键的成本为SimLBR 2.4分[1.9,3.0]和RIGID 3.6分,并耗用被监督的探测器和Déjà VAE两种变体均不足一分. 对于重建探测器来说,它是负的(− 2.6 - 2.6):没有捷径的重建探测器表现得略好一些.
扩大的假象并不能解释这些结果: SimLBR检测到的同尺寸相匹配而必须升级的相较于被降级的相差38%的相差分数(72%对78%).

blocks.en: The detectors we test resize or crop every input to a fixed square, so the shortcut reaches them only through what that does to the image, which is why they depend on it so little. A detector that reads file metadata or aspect ratio, or one trained on data collected the same way, could exploit it fully. We recommend reporting Chameleon results on the size-matched version together with the processing-only control, and we release both as lists of transformations applied to the original files.
blocks.zh: 我们测试的探测器将每个输入的大小调整或裁剪到一个固定的正方形,所以快捷键只能通过对图像的影响来到达它们,这就是为什么它们依赖的很少. 读取文件元数据或相距比的探测器,或接受过同样方法收集数据培训的探测器,可以充分利用它。 我们建议报告变色龙对大小匹配的版本的结果以及只处理的控制,我们同时发布两种结果,作为适用于原始文件的转换列表.

blocks.en: Chameleon can be solved from image width, but resize-first detectors barely use that shortcut. What the benchmark really tests is robustness to one more round of web processing, which costs current detectors 5–11 points.
blocks.zh: 变色龙可以从图像宽度中解出,但改变尺寸的第一探测器几乎不用那个快捷键. 真正测试的基准是坚固到再进行一轮网络处理,这耗费了目前的探测器5到11分。

blocks.en: 10 Is the déjà vu still useful?
blocks.zh: 10个 战争还有用吗?

blocks.en: Question: when the fixed point is too fragile to stand alone, does it add anything to a semantic detector?
blocks.zh: 问:当固定点太脆弱而不能单独存在时,它是否给语义探测器添加了什么?

blocks.en: Adding Déjà VAE-P to the released SimLBR head, by summing their scores after standardising each on real calibration images, raises TPR@5% by 6.3 points on GenImage [5.6, 7.1] , by 3.1 on Chameleon [2.1, 4.1] , by 3.0 on size-matched Chameleon [1.9, 4.3] , and by 11.7 on Synthbuster [9.9, 13.7] (8.1 [6.5, 9.6] with cropped reals; Tables 2 , 10 and 7 ). At the worst generator the gain is 13.3 points on GenImage [11.1, 15.8] and 21.4 on Synthbuster [15.5, 27.4] . False alarms on degraded real images do not rise: 4.1% against 4.2% on GenImage, and 3.5% against 7.7% on Chameleon.
blocks.zh: 将Déjà VAE-P加到释放的SimLBR头上,通过在真实的校正图像上对每个头进行分数标准化后,将TPR@5%在GenImage[5.6,7.1]上提高6.3分,在变色龙[2.1, 4.1]上提高3.1分,在大小相匹配的Chameleon[1.9, 4.3]上提高3.0分,在合成器[9.9, 13.7]上提高11.7分(8.1 [6.5, 9.6]用所收成的真件;表2,10和7). 在最坏的生成器中,GenImage的得分是13.3分[11.1,15.8],合成器的得分是21.4分[15.5,27.4]. 退化真实图像上的假警报没有上升:GenImage4.1%对4.2%,变色龙3.5%对7.7%。

blocks.en: A gain from fusion could come from averaging any two detectors. We therefore compare with four control fusions, each pairing SimLBR with a different second detector. Fusing SimLBR with the supervised probe, a second semantic detector, gains much less: our fusion beats it by 6.3 points [5.6, 6.9] on GenImage and 3.9 [2.9, 4.9] on Chameleon. Our fusion also beats the RIGID fusion (+5.9 [4.6, 7.0] and +11.4 [9.5, 13.2] ) and the reconstruction-probe fusion on Chameleon (+4.8 [3.9, 5.8] ). On GenImage it is only slightly better than the reconstruction-probe fusion on the mean (+0.8 [0.1, 1.5] ) and clearly worse at the worst generator ( − 14.0 -14.0 [ − 16.4 -16.4 , − 11.6 -11.6 ] ). It also beats the AEROBLADE fusion on the AEROBLADE subset ( Appendix C ). Synthbuster is where fusion helps most. There our fusion beats the supervised-probe and reconstruction-probe fusions by 8.5 [7.2, 10.3] and 9.5 [8.1, 11.2] points with downscaled reals and by 9.0 [7.3, 10.8] and 9.7 [8.1, 11.3] with cropped reals, and the RIGID fusion by 19.6 [16.5, 23.2] , while fusing SimLBR with the supervised probe adds 3.1 points [1.6, 5.0] with downscaled reals and nothing with cropped reals ( − 1.0 -1.0 [ − 2.1 -2.1 , 0.1] ). The gain comes from DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2, Firefly and SD 2, where SimLBR is weakest; on GLIDE the fusion falls to 62.8% from SimLBR’s 74.9%.
blocks.zh: 从核聚变得到的收益可能来自平均任何两种探测器。 因此,我们比较了四个控制聚变,每个组合SimLBR和一个不同的第二探测器. 将SimLBR与被监督的探测器(第二个语义探测器)相接,得到的收益要少得多:我们的聚变在GenImage上比它多出6.3分[5.6,6.9],在变色龙上比3.9分[2.9,4.9]. 我们的核聚变还击败了RIGID核聚变(+5.9 [4.6, 7.0]和+11.4 [9.5, 13.2])和Chameleon上的重建-核聚变(+4.8 [3.9, 5.8]). 在基因上,它仅略好于平均值上(+0.8 [0.1, 1.5])的再生-核聚变,在最差的生成器上(-14.0 - 14.0 [-16.4 - 16.4,-11.6 - 11.6]),它也比AEROBLADE子集上的AEROBLADE聚变(附录C)要好得多. 合成器是聚变最能帮助的地方. 在那里,我们的聚变以8.5 [7.2, 10.3]和9.5 [8, 11.2] 的受监督-probe和再生-probe聚变以9.0 [7.3, 10.8]和9.7 [8, 11.3] 的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的活 [1.6, 5.0, 5.0] 的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被收割的被 收益来自DALL \cdot E 2, Firefly和SD 2,其中SimLBR最弱;在GLIDE上,聚变率从SimLBR的74.9%下降到62.8%.

blocks.en: The two Déjà VAE variants trade places here as they do alone. On GenImage the Déjà VAE-I fusion is better (by 2.7 points [2.2, 3.1] ; on Synthbuster by 3.1 [2.3, 3.9] ), and on Chameleon the Déjà VAE-P fusion is better (by 4.8 [4.0, 5.7] ). Déjà VAE-P was the planned method from the start of this study, so we report its fusion throughout rather than picking the better variant per benchmark. The counterfactual rows remain essential: fusing the variant trained without them raises GenImage TPR to 93.6% but flags 20.6% of degraded real images (25.8% on Chameleon).
blocks.zh: 两个Déjà VAE的变体 单独在这里交易 在GenImage上,Déjà VAE-I聚变较好(比2.7分[2.2,3.1];合成 3.1 [2.3,3.9];在Chameleon上,Déjà VAE-P聚变较好(比4.8 [4.0, 5.7]). Déjà VAE-P是本研究一开始就计划采用的方法,因此我们报告整个过程,而不是选择每个基准更好的变体。 反事实行仍然至关重要:将未经过训练的变体引信引信将GenImage TPR提高到93.6%,但标出20.6%已退化的真实图像(Chameleon为25.8%)。

blocks.en: The fixed point carries information that a semantic detector lacks. Fusing the two improves detection on all three benchmarks, including after the size shortcut is removed, and keeps false alarms on degraded real photographs at the base rate.
blocks.zh: 固定点带有语义探测器所缺乏的信息. 使用这两个方法可以改进所有三个基准的检测,包括去除尺寸快捷键之后的检测,并按基准率对已退化的真实相片进行假警报。

blocks.en: 11 Limitations
blocks.zh: 11 限制

blocks.en: We do not claim a state-of-the-art in-the-wild detector: Déjà VAE alone is far below SimLBR on Chameleon. We do not claim that comparing an image with its copy is better than reading the image alone; the answer differs between benchmarks. We do not claim that training without generated images is new ( Section 2 ), and we make no claim about generators whose autoencoders are not in our bank.
blocks.zh: 我们并不声称有最先进的内测器: 单是Déjà VAE就远远低于Chameleon上的SimLBR. 我们并不认为将图像与副本进行比较比只读图像好;答案因基准而异。 我们并不声称没有生成图像的训练是新的(第2节),我们也没有声称发电机的自动编码器不在我们的银行。

blocks.en: Déjà VAE uses no generated images, but it uses the Stable Diffusion autoencoder, which is prior knowledge about how the test generators work; its GenImage advantage is largest on generators that decode through it. Déjà VAE trades generated training images for knowledge of the decoder, and no single copy decoder is best on every benchmark ( Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: Déjà VAE没有使用生成的图像,但是它使用稳定分化自编码器,这是关于测试发电机如何工作的先行知识;它的GenImage优势在通过它解码的发电机上最大. Déjà VAE 行业生成了培训图像,用于了解解码器,而且每个基准上都没有最佳的单一副本解码器(第5节)。

blocks.en: The layers were chosen from a training-free pilot on 2% of the GenImage and 1.3% of the Chameleon test fakes, after the final-layer version had been scored on both test sets ( Section 3.1 ). The full layer curves do not change the choice ( Figure 2 ), and removing all 820 pilot images from the evaluation changes the TPR@5% of SimLBR, Déjà VAE-I and Déjà VAE-P by at most 0.2 points. For the trained head, however, the choice does not transfer: on Synthbuster, the one benchmark held out from it, the final layer is as good with downscaled reals and far better with cropped reals ( Section 7.1 ). A layer choice that is best everywhere remains open.
blocks.zh: 这些层是从一个免费的飞行员中挑选出来的,涉及2%的GenImage和1.3%的变色龙测试假象,这是在两个测试组的最后一级版本都得分之后(第3.1节)。 全层曲线不改变选择(图2),从评价中去掉所有820个试点图像,最多以0.2分改变SimLBR,Déjà VAE-I和Déjà VAE-P的TPR@5%. 然而,对于受过训练的主管来说,选择并不转移:在Synthbuster上,从中得出的一个基准是,最后一层与被缩小的活性一样好,与被收割的活性相比则要好得多(第7.1节)。 每一层都是最好的选择。

blocks.en: GenImage is dated, and its fakes cluster at a few sizes ( Grommelt et al., 2024 ) ; we control its file-format bias but not its size bias. Chameleon is a single web-collected set. Synthbuster has 1,000 images per generator and real images from one camera dataset, and matching them to the generated images’ size has no neutral solution ( Sections 3.4 and 7 ); a benchmark whose real images are produced at the generated images’ sizes would avoid the choice. AEROBLADE is evaluated on a fixed subset and a 256-pixel crop to keep its cost comparable, and RIGID’s noise convention is unspecified, so we report both. We do not compare with detectors that bring their own backbone and training data, such as AIDE ( Yan et al., 2025 ) , DRCT ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , DDA ( Chen et al., 2025 ) or SPAI ( Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ) : our comparisons hold backbone, head and protocol fixed so that differences can be attributed to the signal, and our numbers are not a ranking of published detectors.
blocks.zh: GenImage是过时的,它的假星团有几分大小(Grommelt等,2024年;我们控制它的文件格式偏差,但不控制它的大小偏差. 变色龙是一款被网络收集的单集. 合成器每个生成器有1000个图像,一个相机数据集有真实的图像,与生成的图像大小相匹配没有中性解决方案(第3.4和7节);以生成的图像大小产生真实图像的基准可以避免选择. AEROBLADE被评估在一个固定子集和一个256像素作物上,以保持其成本的可比较性,而RIGID的噪声常规没有说明,所以我们报告两者。 我们不与提供自身骨干和培训数据的探测器进行比较,例如AIDE(Yan等,2025年),DRCT(Chen等,2024年),DDA。 (Chen等,2025年)或SPAI(Karageorgiou等,2025年) :我们的比较具有主干、头和协议固定,以便差异可归因于信号,我们的数字不是公布的探测器的排名。

blocks.en: The bank results depend on knowing a generator’s autoencoder. For SDXL we identified the matching version only after the pre-specified test failed; we cannot verify that the DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 service ran the released consistency decoder; and Midjourney’s and Firefly’s architectures are not public. The bank’s thresholds are set in-sample, and unrelated autoencoders can detect up to 81% of a generator’s images, so a high rate points to a decoder only when it is the highest in its row.
blocks.zh: 银行结果取决于了解一个发电机的自动编码器。 对SDXL来说,我们只有在预先指定的测试失败后才确定匹配的版本;我们无法核实DALL \\cdot E 3服务运行了发布的一致性解码器;而Midjourney和Firefly的架构并不公开. 银行的阈值被设定在样本中,不相关的自动编码器可以检测到高达81%的发电机图像,因此,高速率指向解码器只有在排行中最高时才能检测出.

blocks.en: All experiments ran on one laptop (Apple M5, 16 GB unified memory, PyTorch MPS backend). At test time, Déjà VAE-I costs one DINOv3 pass (58 ms per image), the same as SimLBR, and Déjà VAE-P and Déjà VAE-TF add a copy and a second pass (329 ms; Appendix A ). Scoring a full benchmark, which also copies a blurred version of every test real, takes 2.5–4.5 hours, and the heads train on the CPU in minutes. Memory limited the training set (5,000 real photographs for Déjà VAE, 10,000 images per class for the retrained baselines); the retrained SimLBR gains at most 1.7 points from 5,000 to 10,000 per class ( Appendix I ). We did not vary the training-set size of Déjà VAE.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在一个笔记本电脑上(Apple M5,16 GB统一内存,PyTorch MPS后端). 在测试时,Déjà VAE-I要花费1个DINov3通行证(每幅图像58ms),与SimLBR一样,Déjà VAE-P和Déjà VAE-TF增加一个副本和第二个通行证(329ms;附录A.). 扫描一个完整的基准,该基准还复制了每个测试真实的模糊版本,需要2.5–4.5小时,而头部在几分钟后在CPU上进行训练. 记忆限制了训练集(为Déjà VAE拍摄了5 000张真实相片,为重新训练的基线,每班有10 000张图像);将SimLBR的成绩从每班的5 000分提高到了10 000分(附录一)。 我们没有改变 " Déjà VAE " 的培训规模。

blocks.en: 12 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 12 结论

blocks.en: A generated image’s déjà vu is real but narrow. Without training, a frozen foundation model sees it mainly in intermediate layers and much less at the final layer that detectors usually read; a head trained on autoencoder copies finds a difference there too, but one that is no more robust to compression. Where it can be tested cleanly, it belongs to the generator’s exact decoder: on Synthbuster, exact decoders catch 94–100% of the images of four Stable Diffusion versions without any training, and near-identical versions of the same decoders 7–42%. A detector trained on real photographs and their copies matches a detector trained on 162k generated images on GenImage and complements it in fusion. On a size-controlled modern benchmark it leads or trails depending on how the real photographs are matched; read at the final layer (post hoc), it leads under both. One resize with re-compression, or a mild blur, costs the trained detectors 19–27 points, an unmatched decoder removes most of the training-free signal, and on web images no autoencoder we tried restores it. Two benchmark lessons are independent of the trace. A widely used in-the-wild benchmark can be solved from image width, although resize-first detectors barely use that shortcut. And when real photographs must be matched to the size of generated images, the matching itself can reverse a detector comparison, so benchmarks built this way should report more than one matching. We hope the protocol, the size-matched Chameleon and the two matched versions of Synthbuster help the next detector be measured against what the open web actually does to images.
blocks.zh: 所生成的影像, 不经过训练,被冻结的地基模型主要在中间地层中看到,在探测器通常读取的最后地层则更少;受过自编码器拷贝训练的头部也发现那里有区别,但是没有更坚固的来压缩. 在可以进行清洁测试的地方,它属于生成器精确的解码器:在合成器上,精确的解码器捕捉到94-100%的4个稳定分解版本的图像,没有经过任何训练,几乎相同版本的同一解码器7-42%. 接受过真实照片及其复制品培训的探测器与经过162克生成的GenImage图像培训的探测器相匹配,并在聚变中加以补充. 在大小控制的现代基准上,它根据真实照片的配对情况而引导或跟踪;在最后一层(特设后)读取,则在这两层下引导。 用再压缩或轻度模糊来调整大小, 使训练有素的探测器花费了19–27分, 无法匹配的解码器去除大多数训练无能信号, 两项基准经验教训独立于追踪。 一个被广泛使用的"万花齐放"(in-the-wild)基准可以从图像宽度中解出,尽管调整大小的第一探测器几乎不用这个快捷键. 而当真实相片必须与生成相片的大小相匹配时,相配本身可以逆向进行探测器比较,因此这种方法所建立的基准应该报告一个以上的相配. 我们希望协议,大小匹配的变色龙和Synthbuster的两个相匹配的版本帮助根据打开的网络对图像的实际作用来测量下一个探测器.

blocks.en: Broader Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响说明

blocks.en: Detectors of generated images are used in journalism, content moderation and forensics, where a false accusation can harm a real person. We report false-alarm rates on degraded real photographs for every method, and we show that a widely used benchmark overstates in-the-wild performance. Our results also show how this kind of detector can be evaded: one resize and JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs the trained detectors 19–27 points. We report this because the weakness exists whether or not it is published, and because defenders who deploy such detectors need to know it, for example to combine them with detectors that are robust to processing, as our fusion results suggest. We release code and per-image scores, not images, and we informed the Chameleon authors of the metadata shortcut before releasing this work.
blocks.zh: 生成的图像的探测器被用于新闻、内容节制和法证,其中虚假指控可能伤害到真实的人。 我们报告每种方法的退化真实相片上的假警报率,我们显示,广泛使用的基准超标性能。 我们的结果还表明,这种探测器如何可以被避开:一个调整大小和JPEG重新保住,或者一个轻微模糊,使训练有素的探测器花费了19到27分。 我们之所以报告这一点,是因为无论是否公布,还是因为部署这种探测器的维权者需要知道这一点,例如,正如我们的核聚变结果所显示的那样,将这些探测器与能够处理的探测器结合起来。 我们发布代码和每个图像的分数,而不是图像,我们在发布本作之前,将元数据快捷键告知了变色龙的作者.

blocks.en: The RIGID paper specifies λ = 0.05 \lambda=0.05 and DINOv2 ViT-L/14 but not where the noise is added or how images are preprocessed. On a fixed GenImage subset of 4,000 images we compare noise added in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] pixel space with noise added to the normalised input, each with and without the JPEG q95 re-save. TPR@5%: pixel noise 30.9 (raw) / 29.1 (q95); normalised noise 44.1 (raw) / 38.9 (q95). blocks.en: Table 4 scores every method on the same subset rows as AEROBLADE, so all comparisons with AEROBLADE are paired. On these rows the Déjà VAE-P + SimLBR fusion beats the AEROBLADE + SimLBR fusion by 2.6 points [0.8, 4.4] on GenImage and 2.5 [0.5, 4.8] on Chameleon, and the AEROBLADE fusion flags 17–18% of degraded real images. On Synthbuster, where the generated images were never compressed, AEROBLADE might be handicapped by the JPEG re-save that every evaluation image receives. Scored on the original files of the same rows, it detects 10.8% at a 5% false-positive rate (8.9% with the re-save), and 7.0–8.5% of SD 1.3, 1.4 and 2 images, whose autoencoders it uses.
blocks.zh: 表4在与AEROBLADE相同的子集行上给每个方法打分,因此与AEROBLADE的所有比较都是对的. 在这些行上,Déjà VAE-P + Sim LBR聚变将AEROBLADE + SimLBR聚变在基因上以2.6分[0.8, 4.4]和变色龙上以2.5分[0.5, 4.8分]击败,AEROBLADE聚变旗帜被退化出17-18%的真实图像. 在合成器上,生成的图像从未被压缩过,AEROBLADE可能会被JPEG重新保存每个评价图像接收的功能所阻塞. 在同一行的原始文件中,它以5%的虚假阳性率(8.9%与再保存)检测出10.8%,并检测到7.0-8.5%的SD 1.3,1.4和2等图像,它使用的是其自动编码器.
