blocks.en: Appendix D Processing-aware training
blocks.zh: 附录D 处理意识培训

blocks.en: If processing is the problem, training on processed rows should fix it. We retrain Déjà VAE with every training row passed through the same random processing: JPEG at quality 60–90 with probability 0.5, then a resize from { × 0.5 , … , × 1.5 } \{\times 0.5,\dots,\times 1.5\} with probability 0.7, applied identically to the real, simulated-fake and counterfactual rows. On the controlled grid this recovers part of the loss: × 1.5 \times 1.5 goes from 72.9% to 85.3%, and × 0.75 \times 0.75 + q75 from 78.4% to 83.3%. It does not help on Chameleon (Déjà VAE-P 48.1% vs. 49.2%), and it costs the untouched Chameleon fakes 17 points (75% → \to 58%). The false-positive rate on JPEG q75 reals at a fixed threshold stays at 12–16%, and on resized reals it roughly doubles ( Figure 4 b; × 0.5 \times 0.5 : 6.4% → \to 11.2%, × 1.5 \times 1.5 : 7.0% → \to 12.8%). Training on processed images makes the detector more sensitive to processing itself.
blocks.zh: 如果处理是问题所在,处理后行的训练应当加以修补. 我们重新训练Déjà VAE 每行训练都经过同样的随机处理: JPEG在质量60–90带有概率为0.5,然后从 {× 0.5,.,} × 1.5 } {时间为 0.5,\dots,\times 1.5}带有概率为 0.7, 应用与真实的,模拟的和反事实行相同. 在控制网格上,这可收回部分损失:x 1.5\时从72.9%上升到85.3%;x0.75\时从0.75+q75从78.4%上升到83.3%。 它对Chameleon没有帮助(Déjà VAE-P 48.1% vs 49.2%),它花费了未变异的Chameleon 伪造了17分(75% ~\= 58%). JPEG q75 固定阈值的假阳性率保持在 12 - 16%,在调整后,实际值大致翻了一番(图4 b; × 0.5\时: 6.4% → 至 11.2%; × 1.5\时) 1.5: 7.0%~\=12.8%). 处理后图像的培训使探测器对处理本身更加敏感.

blocks.en: Appendix E Layer and counterfactual ablations
blocks.zh: 附录E 层和反事实分解

blocks.en: The final-layer variant is the first version of Déjà VAE. Its heads were trained and scored on GenImage and Chameleon before the training-free layer diagnostic ( Section 4 ) led us to layers 8–18. We made that switch before the intermediate-layer heads had been evaluated; it raised GenImage and lowered Chameleon, and we kept it. Its Synthbuster scores, the processing and blur tests and the linear probes below were computed after all main results and are post hoc.
blocks.zh: 最终层变体是Déjà VAE的第一个版本. 在无训练层诊断(第4节)导致我们进入第8至18层之前, 在中间层头部被评估之前,我们做了这个切换; 它提升了基因,降低了变色龙,我们保留了它。 它的合成分数,处理和模糊的测试以及下面的线性探测器都是在所有主要结果之后计算出来的,是临时的。

blocks.en: Table 5 changes one factor of Déjà VAE-I at a time; everything else (training images, head, seeds, evaluation) is unchanged. Reading the final layer instead of layers 8–18 costs 8.0 points on GenImage [6.5, 9.4] but gains 27.2 on Chameleon [24.4, 30.2] . For Déjà VAE-P the same change costs 2.5 points on GenImage [0.9, 4.1] and gains 14.9 on Chameleon [12.5, 17.7] . On Synthbuster with downscaled reals (intervals resample photographs), the final layer costs Déjà VAE-I nothing ( + 1.1 +1.1 [ − 1.2 -1.2 , 3.4] ) and raises its worst generator by 34.8 points [29.4, 40.3] ; for Déjà VAE-P it gains 12.2 [9.8, 14.5] . With cropped reals the final layer gains 18.1 points for Déjà VAE-I [14.5, 21.4] and 20.7 for Déjà VAE-P [16.1, 25.1] , so the final-layer heads barely depend on the matching (Déjà VAE-I: 85.7% and 86.3%; ahead of SimLBR by 5.5 [2.9, 8.6] and 8.4 [5.9, 10.9] ). The change is not uniform across generators. With the final layer, Déjà VAE-I detects far more GLIDE (69.7% vs. 35.1%) and DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 images (84.4% vs. 62.6%), and fewer images of SD 2, whose decoder makes the copies (86.7% vs. 98.8%), DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2 (80.0% vs. 93.7%) and Firefly (88.7% vs. 98.3%). This is what one would expect if the intermediate layers carry most of the copy decoder’s trace and the final layer a more generic difference that a trained head can also use; the training-free score, which has no head, detects 40.2% of SD 2 images at layer 16 and 25.4% at the final layer. Layers 8–18 are therefore not uniformly best for a trained head.
blocks.zh: 表5一次改变Déjà VAE-I的一个系数;其他所有因素(训练图像、头、种子、评价)不变。 在GenImage[6.5, 9.4]上读取最后一层,而不是第8–18层,花费了8.0分,但在Chameleon[24.4, 30.2]上却获得了27.2分. 对Déjà VAE-P来说,同样的改变费用在GenImage上为2.5分[0.9, 4.1],在Chameleon上为14.9分[12.5,17.7]. 在缩放实相的合成上(中间再取相片),最后一层成本为Déjà VAE-I nothing (+ 1.1 + 1.1 [− 1.2-1.2, 3.4]),将最差的发生器提升了34.8分[29.4, 40.3];对Déjà VAE-P来说,它得到12.2 [9.8, 14.5]. 最终层积分为:Déjà VAE-I [14.5, 21.4]和Déjà VAE-P [16.1, 25.1] 的积分为18.1分,因此最终层头几乎不取决于相配(Déjà VAE-I:85.7%和86.3%;比SimLBR领先5.5 [2.9, 8.6]和8.4 [5.9, 10.9])。 发电机的变动并不一致。 最后一层,Déjà VAE-I探测到的GLIDE(69.7%对35.1%)和DALL \\cdot E 3图像(84.4%对62.6%),SD 2的图像较少,后者的解码器制作副本(86.7%对98.8%)、DALL \cdot E 2(80.0%对93.7%)和Firefly(88.7%对98.3%)。 如果中间层携带大部分副本解码器的踪迹,而最后层则有更通用的区别,而训练有素的头也可以使用;没有头的训练无分数在16层检测出40.2%的SD 2图像,在最后层检测出25.4%。 因此,第8至18层对受过训练的主管来说并不统一。

blocks.en: The final layer is not blind to the copy. A linear head trained on the same rows as Déjà VAE-I (real photographs, their copies and the counterfactual reals; same optimiser, steps and seeds) detects 73.2% of GenImage’s generated images from the final-layer class token, against 79.5% for the MLP head, and 60.8% and 90.4% on Chameleon and Synthbuster with downscaled reals (MLP 61.2% and 85.7%; with cropped reals 88.8% and 86.3%). At layers 8–18 the linear head gives 85.6%, 38.3% and 85.6% (MLP 87.5%, 33.9% and 84.5%), and 52.4% with cropped reals (MLP 68.2%). To test the blindness reported by Zhou et al. (2026) directly, we copied 1,000 GenImage test reals (long side at most 640 pixels) once at full resolution with ft-MSE, the SD 2 autoencoder, and scored the copies with every detector at its usual threshold. The originals are flagged at 4–5%. Probes trained on SD 1.4 images flag 15–25% of the copies (SimLBR released 24.9%, retrained 20.1%, supervised probe 15.2%), close to the blindness Zhou et al. report. Heads trained on copies flag more: the reconstruction probe 32.0% (it was trained on copies of squashed images, whereas here the image is squashed after the copy), final-layer Déjà VAE-I 50.1%, and Déjà VAE-I on layers 8–18 97.6%. Both the training target and the layer therefore matter.
blocks.zh: 最后一层不是对副本视而不见. 接受过与Déjà VAE-I(真实相片、复制相片和反事实真相;相同的选取相片、台阶和种子)相同一行培训的线性头部检测出73.2%的基因源生成的来自末级标志的图像,而MLP头部为79.5%,而Chameleon和Synthbuster上为60.8%和90.4%,降级为真相(MLP 61.2%和85.7%;收成为88.8%和86.3%)。 第8至18层的线头为85.6%、38.3%和85.6%(87.5%、33.9%和84.5%),有耕地的52.4%(68.2%)。 以检验周等所报失明. (2026)直接复制了1000个GenImage测试真能(最长的一面为640像素),一次以Ft-MSE,SD 2自动编码器的全分辨率复制,并按通常的阈值与每个探测器打分. 原件标记为4-5%。 在SD 1.4图像上接受过测试的探测器标出15-25%的拷贝(SimLBR发布24.9%,再培训20.1%,受监督的探测器15.2%),接近盲周等. 报告。 头部接受过更多关于复制旗帜的培训:重建探测器32.0%(它接受过关于被压碎的图像复制品的培训,而这里的图像在复制后被压平了)、最后层的Déjà VAE-I 50.1%,以及地层8-18的Déjà VAE-I 97.6%。 因此,培训目标与层层都很重要。

blocks.en: The final-layer head is not robust to processing either. On the controlled grid of Section 8 (SD 1.4, Wukong and Midjourney), it starts at 78.6% (layers 8–18: 97.2%) and is below the intermediate-layer head under every processing step. It loses less to resizing (a × 1.5 \times 1.5 upscale: + 1.8 +1.8 points, against − 2.2 -2.2 ) and to the mild blur of Section 8 (79.5% → \to 64.0% on the 1,600 GenImage fakes, against 87.9% → \to 61.1%), but as much or more to JPEG q75 ( − 15.0 -15.0 , against − 9.7 -9.7 ), and its false-alarm rate on processed reals at a fixed threshold stays between 2.2% and 8.0% (layers 8–18: 6.6–18.6%). On Chameleon it detects as many generated images whose sides are not multiples of 8 pixels, which have almost certainly been resized, as untouched ones (61.6% vs. 57.5%); the intermediate-layer head detects 28.5% vs. 51.1%. The final-layer head thus reads a difference that is less tied to the copy decoder and less sensitive to resizing and blur, but not to compression. We have not identified what this difference is, and we do not claim that it survives web processing.
blocks.zh: 最终层头也不太能处理. 在8节(SD 1.4,Wukong和Midjourney)的控制网格上起步为78.6%(层8–18:97.2%),并低于每个处理步骤下的中间层头. 其损失较少的是重新调整大小(1.5分1.5分:+1.8分+1.8分,对-2.2-2.2分),以及第8节(79.5%-=64.0%在1 600个基因假象上,对87.9%-==61.1%),但JPEG q75(15.0-15.0分,对-9.7-9.7分)及其在固定阈值停留在2.2%至8.0%(第8至18级:6.6至18.6%)的经处理的活品上的假警报率。 在Chameleon上,它探测到许多生成的图像,其侧面不是8像素的倍数,几乎可以肯定地说,这些图像的大小已经改变,是未变的(61.6%对57.5%);中间层头部探测到28.5%对51.1%。 最终的层头因此读取了一种差异,与副本解码器的绑定较少,对重定大小和模糊度的敏感度也较少,而不会被压缩. 我们尚未查明这种区别是什么,我们也没有声称它在网络处理中生存。

blocks.en: Removing the counterfactual rows raises TPR@5% slightly (by 5.3 points on GenImage [4.7, 6.0] , 1.9 on Chameleon [0.9, 3.0] and 0.3 on Synthbuster [ − 0.6 -0.6 , 1.4] ) but multiplies false alarms on degraded real images by four to six. We did not retrain Déjà VAE-I on squashed images; for the training-free signal, squashing the image to 256 × 256 256\times 256 before the copy costs 0.075 AUROC ( Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 删除反事实行可以稍微提高TPR@5%(在GenImage[4.7,6.0]上5.3分,在变色龙[0.9,3.0]上1.9分,在合成器[−0.6-0.6,1.4]上0.3分),但将退化的真实图像上的假警报乘以4到6分. 我们没有将Déjà VAE-I重新训练在被压平的图像上;对于无训练信号,在复制成本为0.075 AUROC(第4节)之前将图像压到256×256256分/次256分。

Rows in which the difference has the same sign and excludes zero under both matchings are the ones the main text relies on. With cropped reals, training Déjà VAE-I without counterfactual rows changes mean TPR@5% by − 2.0 -2.0 [ − 5.3 -5.3 , 0.8] (downscaled: + 0.3 +0.3 [ − 0.6 -0.6 , 1.4] ).
blocks.zh: 表6给出了Déjà VAE-I和SimLBR在真实相片的两种匹配方式(第7节)下发布的每台相机头相片,并配对间隔,其中校正真相片由相片复制,而每个相机生成相片由相片复制(B=1000 B=1{,}000). 在两种匹配下,差异具有相同标志并排除0的行是正文所依赖的行. 有了被收割的活性,培训Déjà VAE-I没有反事实行变化,意味着TPR@5%到−2.0-2.0[− 5.3-5.3,0.8](缩小:+0.3+0.3 [−0.6-0.6,1.4])。

blocks.en: As on GenImage, Déjà VAE-P is behind Déjà VAE-I (74.7%; − 9.8 -9.8 [ − 11.6 -11.6 , − 7.9 -7.9 ] ; with cropped reals − 5.1 -5.1 [ − 9.3 -9.3 , − 1.4 -1.4 ] ). Read at the final layer, Déjà VAE-P detects 86.9% and Déjà VAE-I 85.7% with downscaled reals ( Appendix E ). The single-layer training-free scores fail after the JPEG re-save: Déjà VAE-TF detects 23.5% (40.2% even on SD 2, whose decoder is ours), RIGID with DINOv3 26.6%, and RIGID with DINOv2, the published configuration, 5.4%. AEROBLADE, on its fixed subset ( Appendix C ), detects 8.9%, and at most 7% of SD 1.3, SD 1.4 and SD 2 images although it uses their own autoencoders; Déjà VAE-I is 77.1 points above it [73.3, 80.7] . Without the re-save AEROBLADE detects 10.8%, so the re-save is not why it fails here. The decoder bank of Section 5 removes the re-save and reads several layers.
blocks.zh: 关于Genimage, Déjà VAE-P在Déjà VAE-I后面(74.7%;- 9.8-9.8 [- 11.6-11.6,- 7.9-7.9]; 有收成的活性[- 9.3-9.3,- 1.4-1.4]). 在最后一层读取, Déjà VAE-P 发现86.9%, Déjà VAE-I 发现85.7%的活性缩小(附录E)。 JPEG再保级后单层无训练分数失败: Déjà VAE-TF探测到23.5%(40.2%,甚至在SD 2上,其解码器是我们的),RIGID为DINov3 26.6%,RIGID为DINov2,发布配置为5.4%。 AEROBLADE在其固定子集(附录C)上探测到8.9%,最多探测到7%的SD 1.3、SD 1.4和SD 2等图像,尽管它们使用自己的自动编码器;Déjà VAE-I比它高77.1分[73.3,80.7]。 没有重新保存的AEROBLADE探测到10.8%,所以重新保存不是它在这里失败的原因. 第5节的解码器库去掉再保存并读取多层.

blocks.en: With downscaled reals, the consistency decoder’s TPR on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 (34.5%) is the highest in its row, but its AUROC (0.75) is below those of ft-MSE, SDXL and FLUX (0.84–0.86). With cropped reals the prediction fails: the consistency decoder detects 38.0% and the SDXL autoencoder 78.5%. On the pixel-space generators no autoencoder exceeds 44% (DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2) and 41.5% (GLIDE). Firefly is invisible to every autoencoder (at most 8.5%), although Déjà VAE-I detects 98% of it. On Midjourney v5, ft-MSE detects 91.0% and attracts 81.5% of the attributions. When each SD image is attributed to the autoencoder under which it moves least, 100%, 98.5% and 94.5% of the SD 1.3, 1.4 and 2 images go to their own decoder, and with the post-hoc SDXL version 99.5% of the SDXL images.
blocks.zh: 以缩放的真能表示,DALL \\cdot E 3 (34.5%)上的一致性解码器TPR是其行中最高的,但其AUROC(0.75)低于ft-MSE,SDXL和FLUX(0.84–0.86). 随着收割真实性,预测失败:一致性解码器检测出38.0%,SDXL自编码器检测出78.5%. 在像素空间发电机上,自动编码器不超过44%(DALL \\cdot E2)和41.5%(GLIDE)。 虽然Déjà VAE-I探测到98%,但每个自动编码器都看不见萤火虫(最多8.5%). 在Midjourney v5上,ft-MSE检测到91.0%,吸引了81.5%的归属. 当每个SD图像被归结为它移动最少的自编码器时,SD 1.3, 1.4和2等图像的100%,98.5%和94.5%到自己的解码器上去,而后Hoc SDXL版本的SDXL图像为 99.5%.

blocks.en: Figure 6 gives the training-free bank on GenImage, with every view re-saved as JPEG q95, and on Chameleon ( Section 5 ). Figure 7 repeats the bank of Figure 6 on the files as distributed, without the JPEG re-save. GenImage’s real images are JPEG and its generated images PNG. On the original files every autoencoder appears to detect the SD1-based images, including the unrelated MoVQ (90–97%), and SD1’s decoder appears to detect VQDM (84%); with the re-save these cross-detections disappear (MoVQ 16–25% on SD1-based images, SD1’s decoder 20% on VQDM). blocks.en: Table 7 compares Déjà VAE trained on copies from SD1’s original decoder with the main version, whose copies come from ft-MSE; everything else is identical (training images, heads, seeds, evaluation). The rows marked in the “Pred.” column carry the signs we wrote down before training ( Section 5 ); all hold. Beyond the predictions, the copy decoder moves whole benchmarks, and not in one direction. On GenImage the SD1-decoder detector is better overall (Déjà VAE-I +4.0 [3.2, 4.9] ; Déjà VAE-P +11.4 [10.5, 12.3] ). This includes gains of about 11 points for Déjà VAE-I on ADM, BigGAN and GLIDE, which have no SD1 decoder, so this gain is not decoder matching; we have not isolated its cause. On Synthbuster Déjà VAE-I loses 6.0 points [ − 7.1 -7.1 , − 5.1 -5.1 ] , mostly on Midjourney ( − 24.5 -24.5 ), DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 ( − 18.3 -18.3 ) and SDXL ( − 11.3 -11.3 ), while Déjà VAE-P gains 3.4 [2.2, 4.7] . On Chameleon both lose about 20 points.

blocks.en: For each fake i i (seed 17) we draw a real image j j uniformly and set the target size to ( 500 , H j ) (500,H_{j}) . The fake is centre-cropped to aspect H j / 500 H_{j}/500 (height cropped if the fake is relatively taller, width otherwise), resized with bicubic interpolation (antialiased), and saved with PIL as baseline JPEG, quality 75, 4:2:0 subsampling, no metadata. The median resize factor is 0.71; 37.9% of fakes are upscaled; the crop keeps a median of 66% of the image area. The processing-only control applies the same resize factor to the uncropped fake (so its aspect ratio and full content are kept) and the same JPEG settings. Metadata audit: Figure 5 b; decomposition with intervals: Figure 9 .

blocks.en: Code and data: https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae . The repository contains: • the code for every experiment and figure, with the pipeline scripts in the order they were run; • per-image scores of every method and seed on every benchmark, including degraded real images and the AEROBLADE subsets, keyed by each image’s path relative to its dataset’s root, so that every number in the paper can be recomputed without images; • the lists that rebuild size-matched Chameleon, its processing-only control and both matched Synthbuster splits (downscaled and cropped) from the original datasets (file names and target sizes only, no image content); • the decoder-bank reports for Synthbuster, as produced before and after the post-hoc SDXL analysis. We release no images. GenImage, Chameleon, Synthbuster and RAISE-1k are available from their authors. All public model weights are loaded by name from their public repositories ( Appendix A ).
